author.name: Xiaomeng Fan, Wu Wei, Yuwei Wu, Zhi Gao, Shiyu Luo, Mingyang Gao, Haoyu Zhao, Zhenxin Diao, Yuxuan Ba, Lijia Feng, Yunde Jia, Mehrtash Harandi

entry.summary: This work shows fine-grained generation in MLLMs is more error-prone than coarse-grained, and introduces GranFact, a granularity-aware benchmark with coarse-to-fine annotations and a hierarchy-aware evaluation to assess reliability. It argues models should generate the finest reliable description rather than the most specific.

entry.title: Concept Removal Guidance: Evidence-Calibrated Negative Guidance for Safe Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Yoonseok Choi, Chaeyoung Oh, Hyunjun Choi, Seokin Seo, Kee-Eung Kim

entry.summary: Concept Removal Guidance (CRG) is a training-free method for safe diffusion sampling that estimates unwanted-concept presence from evolving image evidence along the denoising trajectory to calibrate negative guidance. It addresses the safety-fidelity trade-off of fixed-weight negative guidance and the brittleness of posterior-odds variants.

entry.title: Clearer Sight, Fewer Lies: Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Xin Zou, Haolin Deng, Yibo Yan, Shuliang Liu, Zhiwei Jin, Chen Chen, Haonan Lu, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: OPPO (Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization) is an evidence-aware alignment objective for mitigating multimodal LLM hallucination, motivated by the observation that strengthening query-relevant visual evidence via attention improves accuracy. It learns preferences over evidence strengthening so models better trust attended visual evidence.

entry.title: RainODE: Continuous-Time Precipitation Forecasting with Latent Neural ODEs

author.name: Yeeun Seong, Doyi Kim, Minseok Seo, Changick Kim

entry.summary: RainODE reformulates precipitation forecasting as a continuous-time dynamical system using latent Neural ODEs, enabling derivative-consistent temporal dynamics and higher temporal resolution. It augments deterministic ODE dynamics to capture non-advective intensity changes like localized growth and decay.

entry.title: StrucTab: A Structured Optimization Framework for Table Parsing

author.name: Gengluo Li, Shangpin Peng, Chengquan Zhang, Binghong Wu, Hao Feng, Weinong Wang, Pengyuan Lyu, Huawen Shen, Xingyu Wan, Zhuotao Tian, Han Hu, Can Ma, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: StrucTab is a table-parsing model that uses intermediate structural supervision and reward decomposition to convert table images into machine-readable structure, addressing unstable RL reward designs in VLM-based parsing. It introduces explicit intermediate reasoning rather than only supervising final output.

entry.title: CylindTrack: Depth-Aware Cylindrical Motion Modeling for Panoramic Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Buyin Deng, Kai Luo, Lingxin Huang, Xinqi Liu, Fei Cheng, Hang Zheng, Liming Yin, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: CylindTrack introduces depth-aware cylindrical motion modeling for panoramic multi-object tracking, addressing the periodic horizontal domain and unreliable IoU association near the 0/360 degree seam in equirectangular videos. It targets embodied perception with 360-degree cameras.

entry.title: T2LDM++: A Self-Conditioned Representation Guided Diffusion Model for Realistic Text-to-LiDAR Scene Generation

author.name: Wentao Qu, Qi Zhang, Chenxu Wang, Guofeng Mei, Yongfei Liu, Xiaoshui Huang, Gim Hee Lee, Liang Xiao

entry.summary: T2LDM++ is a text-to-LiDAR scene generation diffusion model addressing scarcity of text-LiDAR pairs and over-smoothing via self-conditioned representation guidance with a guidance network providing reconstruction-based soft supervision. It improves controllability and geometry-aware generation.

entry.title: Why can genetic algorithms work in high-dimensional search spaces?

author.name: Stephen Whitelam

entry.summary: This paper shows that the elitist (1+M) genetic algorithm, in the small-mutation limit, behaves as clipped gradient descent under anisotropic Gaussian noise, following the loss gradient without explicit gradient computation. It argues the slowdown versus gradient descent is governed by the effective rank of the loss Hessian rather than parameter count, explaining GA success in high dimensions.

entry.title: CORE: Common Outcome Regularities from Action-Free Visual Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Juyi Sheng, Jincheng Li, Mingxin Tan, Mengyuan Liu

entry.summary: CORE learns from action-free visual demonstrations (like human videos) by exploiting the observation that successful trajectories for a task share stable terminal object configurations. It trains a terminal outcome encoder to guide manipulation policies without transferring explicit actions.

entry.title: Analytic Concept-Centric Memory for Agentic Embodied Manipulation

author.name: Mingyang Sun, Xiujian Liang, Jiude Wei, Qichen He, Donglin Wang, Cewu Lu, Jianhua Sun

entry.summary: Proposes an analytic concept-centric memory framework for long-horizon embodied manipulation that organizes experience around structured concepts (semantic parts, parametric templates, poses, affordances, states) connected via transition memory. It improves retrieval of manipulation-relevant knowledge over unstructured histories.

entry.title: STEAM: Self-Supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling for Real-World Robot Learning

author.name: Zhihao Liu, Qiuyi Gu, Yitao Wang, Dongming Qiao, Yixian Zhang, Shuaihang Chen, Liangzhi Shi, Tianxing Zhou, Zefang Huang, Kang Chen, Zhen Guo, Quanlu Zhang, Jincheng Yu, Xiaodan Liang, Guoliang Fan, Yu Wang, Feng Gao, Xinlei Chen, Chao Yu

entry.summary: STEAM is a label-free method that learns frame-level advantages from expert demonstrations by training an ensemble of temporal-offset predictors using normalized temporal offsets between frame pairs as self-supervision. It helps distinguish reliable progress from stalls and regressions in real-world robot learning.

entry.title: Pondering the Way: Spatial-perceiving World Action Model for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Hong Chen, Daqi Liu, Zehan Zhang, Haiguang Wang, Tianhao Lu, Longfei Yan, Haiyang Sun, Fangzhen Li, Hongwei Xie, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Yihua Tan

entry.summary: SWAM is a task-centric world-action model for embodied navigation that, given start and goal RGB observations, performs single-pass inference to jointly generate intermediate RGB-D sequences and action trajectories. It avoids the candidate dependence and overhead of verification-centric world-model planners.

entry.title: WARP: Whole-Body Retargeting for Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations

author.name: Zhenyang Chen, Chuizheng Kong, Chuye Zhang, Yuanshao Yang, Lawrence Y. Zhu, Shreyas Kousik, Danfei Xu

entry.summary: WARP is an offline pipeline for whole-body retargeting from human demonstrations to robots, using a closed-form shoulder-elbow-wrist geometric solver for exact end-effector tracking while preserving whole-body intent. It addresses action multi-modality from imprecise retargeting that prevents policy convergence.

entry.title: ConCent: Contact-Centric Real-to-Sim-to-Real Learning from One Demonstration

author.name: Heecheol Kim, Namiko Saito, Katsushi Ikeuchi, Yasuyuki Matsushita

entry.summary: ConCent is a contact-centric real-to-sim-to-real learning approach that achieves manipulation from a single demonstration by emphasizing contact-centric fidelity, reproducing the contact event sequence and local contact dynamics for sim-to-real transfer. It targets contact-rich tasks where subtle contact differences alter outcomes.

entry.title: X-Morph: Human Motion Priors for Scalable Robot Learning Across Morphologies

author.name: Ritwik Sharma, Shivam Sood, Arhaan Jain, Shyam Charan Kesavamoorthi, Chengyang He, Guillaume Sartoretti

entry.summary: X-Morph converts human motion into deployable locomotion and loco-manipulation policies for diverse non-humanoid legged morphologies (quadrupeds, hexapods, quadruped manipulators) via cross-morphology retargeting that preserves intent while ensuring kinematic plausibility. It addresses motion-data scarcity for non-humanoid robots.

entry.title: Full Conformal Prediction under Stochastic Non-Conformity Measure

author.name: Thanawat Sornwanee

entry.summary: This paper shows that the commonly assumed condition of permutation invariance in distribution is actually insufficient for full conformal prediction validity when the non-conformity measure is stochastic (as arises with ML training). It provides a correct sufficient condition combining conditional independence and permutation invariance in distribution.

entry.title: NormAct: A Benchmark for Hidden Social Norm Compliance in Embodied Planning

author.name: Shiyun Zhao, Xinwei Song, Tianyu Guo, Xiaomeng Gao, Mingyuan Liu, Xu Han, Yuanyuan Zhang, Zhenliang Zhang, Xue Feng, Bo Dai

entry.summary: NormAct is a benchmark evaluating whether embodied MLLM planners can infer and comply with hidden social norms embedded within ordinary tasks, scoring goal achievement, norm compliance, and task success. Targets socially appropriate embodied behavior.

entry.title: Dismantling Pathological Shortcuts: A Causal Framework for Faithful LVLM Decoding

author.name: Liu Yu, Can Chen, Ping Kuang, Zhikun Feng, Fan Zhou, Gillian Dobbie

entry.summary: Fox is a training-free inference-time framework that diagnoses object hallucination in LVLMs as dynamic structural misalignment, where specific attention heads act as risky mediators decoupling from visual evidence to lock onto language priors. Uses a visual attention entropy probe to localize and rectify these heads.

entry.title: Low-Agreeableness Persona Conditioning for Safe LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Austin MY Cheung, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Shows that fine-tuning LLMs for social warmth weakens adversarial safety and increases jailbreak susceptibility, then introduces a persona-driven rewriting pipeline conditioning on low agreeableness paired with warm de-escalating responses. Reduces jailbreak susceptibility across four models.

entry.title: ML-Powered LDAP Reconnaissance Detection using Weak Supervision

author.name: Shaefer Drew, Edward Raff, Michael Brautbar, Yaron Zinar, Benjamin Malmberg, Dor Agron, Sagi Sheinfeld, Avraham Kama, Asaf Romano

entry.summary: Develops two ML frameworks using weak supervision to detect LDAP reconnaissance in Active Directory by correlating queries with endpoint detections. Aims to catch threat actors early in the reconnaissance phase.

entry.title: A Linear Matching Bandit Approach to Online Multi-Human Multi-Robot Teaming

author.name: Yaohui Guo, X. Jessie Yang, Cong Shi

entry.summary: BrainRiem is a source-free domain adaptation framework for cross-site fMRI brain network diagnosis that learns Riemannian brain prototypes on the SPD manifold via Log-Euclidean metric. It avoids needing source data, respecting clinical privacy.

entry.title: ScaleAware-JEPA: Latent Representation for Discovery in Multiscale Physical Fields

author.name: Guang-Xing Li

entry.summary: Introduces ScaleAware-JEPA, a self-supervised framework constructing label-free latent coordinates for continuous multiscale physical fields by separating fields into scale components that define a JEPA masking geometry. It aligns the predictive task with continuous scale hierarchies for scientific discovery.

entry.title: Heads, Not Backbones: Output Heads Dominate Architectures on Fat-Tailed Returns

author.name: Sichao He, Yansong Zhang

entry.summary: Asks whether the backbone architecture or output head matters more in deep forecasting of fat-tailed financial returns, finding across four backbones and three heads on S&P 500 data that output heads (point vs Gaussian vs mixture) dominate performance while backbone choice barely matters. Mixture density heads yield the best CRPS.

entry.title: From Failure Taxonomy to Intervention: A Diagnostic Methodology for Industry-Scale AVLM in Video and Live-Streaming Platform Moderation

author.name: Shuchang Ye, Jinqiang Yu, Zhujun Xiao, Yajing Kong, Yist Y. Lin, Yang Ma, Jiaxi Liu, Xiaolei Xu, Zheng Yu

entry.summary: Presents a diagnostic methodology for industry-scale audio-visual language models in video and live-streaming moderation, translating a failure taxonomy into targeted model-development interventions where generic foundation models fall short. It fills a gap in research that reports architectures and results but not failure localization.

entry.title: Query-Aware Spreading Activation for Multi-Hop Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Illia Makarov, Mykola Glybovets

entry.summary: Proposes a query-aware spreading-activation method for multi-hop retrieval over knowledge graphs that achieves query-aware traversal with a single per-step semantic score, avoiding loading the full graph into memory or running iterative flow-diffusion solvers. It improves on query-blind Graph RAG traversal.

entry.title: A Zero-Shot Deep Image Prior Framework for Denoising and Deconvolution in Fluorescence Microscopy

author.name: Xiangyu Qian, Jing Liu, Yunqing Tang, Luru Dai, Qiushi Li

entry.summary: SDIP is a zero-shot deep image prior framework that sequentially performs denoising then deconvolution for fluorescence microscopy without external paired training data. It combines sequential autoencoding regularization with a wavelet-based background correction and RLG-DIP deconvolution.

entry.title: KM-Speaker: Keypoint-Based Style Control for High-Quality Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation and Dialogue Localization

author.name: Arthur Josi, Emeline Got, Abdallah Dib, Luiz Gustavo Hafemann, Rafael M. O. Cruz

entry.summary: KM-Speaker is a keypoint-conditioned flow-based generative framework for speech-driven 3D facial animation that provides both global style guidance and frame-level control for tasks like dubbing and dialogue localization. It targets production-quality fidelity with precise temporal control.

entry.title: FedLAS: Feature-Modulated Bidirectional Label Smoothing for Neural Network Calibration

author.name: Thiru Thillai Nadarasar Bahavan, Sachith Seneviratne, Saman Halgamuge

entry.summary: FedLAS proposes feature-modulated bidirectional label smoothing for neural network calibration, replacing predefined uniform smoothing rules with adaptive smoothing that addresses both overconfidence and underconfidence. It adapts to per-sample difficulty and the evolving model.

entry.title: A Bayesian latent Gaussian process framework for aerodynamic uncertainty quantification

author.name: Geoffrey Davis, Ashwin Renganathan

entry.summary: This paper develops a Bayesian latent Gaussian process framework using Gaussian process surrogates and Kennedy-O'Hagan calibration for aerodynamic uncertainty quantification, calibrating cheap low-fidelity simulations against sparse, uncertain experimental measurements. It handles uncertainty in both control inputs and measured responses.

entry.title: Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention: A Preliminary Study of Editable Request-Local Memory

author.name: Junyi Zou, Avrova Donz

entry.summary: This preliminary study explores memory-managed long-context attention that separates a fast recurrent or sparse backbone from explicit editable request-local memory slots with query-time sparse fallback. It shows pure fixed-state or pure sparse methods fail overwrite and distractor tasks where the hybrid succeeds.

entry.title: SCARCE: Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings

author.name: Yingjie Wang, Yi Dong, Edmund Lau, Jie Meng, Taylor T Johnson, Xiaowei Huang

entry.summary: SCARCE replaces the handcrafted scalar performance function in Subset Simulation with learned latent representations and geometric rulers to estimate rare-event probabilities for AI systems without detailed failure-geometry knowledge. It enables transfer across domains. It matters for scalable safety-critical rare-event estimation.

entry.title: FacePlex: Full-Duplex Joint Speech-Facial Motion Generation for Conversational Avatars

author.name: Habin Lim, Jae-Ho Lee, Hah Min Lew, Ji-Su Kang, Gyeong-Moon Park

entry.summary: FacePlex formalizes full-duplex joint speech and facial-motion generation, producing speech tokens and facial-motion tokens together every step via Rolling Flow Matching for online motion generation. It bridges speech-only full-duplex models and audio-driven facial animation. It matters for real-time conversational avatars.

entry.title: ENC-ODE: Event-level Neurodegenerative Modeling in Continuous Time with Neural ODEs

author.name: Yujee Song, Seunghun Baek, Guorong Wu, Won Hwa Kim

entry.summary: ENC-ODE models neurodegenerative biomarker progression in continuous time using neural ODEs with diagnosis-conditioned dynamics and event-level attention. It handles sparse, irregular longitudinal clinical data for diseases like Alzheimer's.

entry.title: Wireless Backdoor Attack and Defense for Semantic Communications over Multiple Access Channel

author.name: Yalin E. Sagduyu, Tugba Erpek, Aylin Yener, Sennur Ulukus

entry.summary: Investigates a selective over-the-air backdoor (Trojan) attack and corresponding defense for semantic communication systems over a multiple access channel with two transmitters. It highlights new vulnerabilities introduced by deploying semantic comms in shared wireless networks.

entry.title: TriageRA-CCF: Source-Side Clinical Confidence and Coverage Signals for Adaptive Rank Budgeting in Medical LLMs

author.name: Shucan Ji, Yining Huang, Hongliang Guo

entry.summary: TriageRA-CCF is a source-side teacher for adaptive LoRA rank budgeting in medical QA that decides per-question whether to activate small, medium, or large rank subsets using base-model confidence, clinical coverage, and difficulty signals. It prevents router collapse and capacity waste under distribution shift.

entry.title: Cross-Temporal Sinhala OCR: Page-Level Adaptation and Diachronic Analysis

author.name: Avisha Dilhara, Nevidu Jayatilleke

entry.summary: Introduces the first publicly available real-world page-level Sinhala OCR dataset of 1,010 annotated legislative-act images and fine-tunes OCR-VLMs via QLoRA, also analyzing diachronic script variation across decades. It bridges a major resource gap for Sinhala document OCR.

entry.title: LC-ICL: Label-Guided Contrastive In-Context Learning for Robust Information Extraction

author.name: Xiao You, Tianwei Yan, Shan Zhao

entry.summary: LC-ICL is a few-shot in-context learning technique for information extraction that leverages both correct and incorrect (label-guided contrastive) demonstrations for NER and relation extraction. It exploits the often-neglected value of negative examples.

entry.title: LLM Agents Are Latent Context Managers: Eliciting Self-Managed Context via a Proprioceptive Dashboard

author.name: Binyan Xu, Haitao Li, Kehuan Zhang

entry.summary: Argues frontier LLM agents are proprioceptively blind to their own growing context and introduces VISTA, an interface exposing block size, age, and usage so the model itself can manage context. Hypothesizes competent context management is already latent and just needs an interface.

entry.title: Manufactured Confidence: How Memory Consolidation Turns Hearsay into Confident Facts

author.name: Alex Kwon

entry.summary: Shows that LLM agent memory products like mem0 and LangMem rewrite hedged remarks into confident dated facts that later steps obey, manufacturing unwarranted confidence without any attacker. Isolates that agents respond to phrasing confidence rather than source attribution, granting above-clearance requests.

entry.title: MaDI-Bench: An End-to-End Data Integration Benchmark

author.name: Aaron Steiner, Ralph Peeters, Christian Bizer

entry.summary: MaDI-Bench is the first end-to-end data integration benchmark covering all interdependent steps from schema matching to data fusion for relational tables, addressing the lack of holistic pipeline benchmarks. It enables research on integration as a complete process rather than isolated tasks.

entry.title: Physics-Grounded Disentangled Flow Modeling for Brain Disease Progression Trajectory

author.name: Jun Wang, Peirong Liu

entry.summary: PDF is a physics-grounded disentangled flow-matching framework for forecasting longitudinal brain lesion progression, decomposing modeling into separate morphology evolution and intensity variation processes for greater physical plausibility and interpretability. It addresses entangled modeling limitations in disease trajectory prediction.

entry.title: AEGIR: Modeling Area Emitters for Indoor Inverse Rendering using Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Mohamed Shawky Sabae, Philipp Langsteiner, Jan-Niklas Dihlmann, Hendrik Lensch

entry.summary: AEGIR explicitly models local area emitters within a relightable Gaussian Splatting representation for indoor inverse rendering, correcting the unrealistic shadows and light attenuation that arise from point-light or environment-map approximations. It jointly optimizes emitters, materials, and geometry.

entry.title: SciFlow: Semantic Cross Interference for Self-Supervised Optical Flow Domain Generalization

author.name: Jamie Menjay Lin, Jisoo Jeong, Hong Cai, Kai Wang, Fatih Porikli

entry.summary: SciFlow is a network-agnostic self-supervised training approach using semantic cross interference to improve synthetic-to-real domain generalization for optical flow estimation, addressing the scarcity of real pixel-wise flow ground truth. It targets practical open-world motion estimation.

entry.title: HiReFF: High-Resolution Feedforward Human Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Sparse-View Video

author.name: Yiming Jiang, Hanzhang Tu, Wenfeng Song, Siyou Lin, Liang An, Shuai Li, Aimin Hao, Yebin Liu

entry.summary: HiReFF is a feed-forward method for 2K-resolution 360-degree human video reconstruction from uncalibrated sparse-view videos, decomposing the task into foreground Gaussian reconstruction and efficient high-resolution synthesis. It surpasses prior low-resolution single-frame feed-forward models.

entry.title: MotionAtlas: Detailed Region Captioning for Motion-Centric Videos

author.name: Weisong Liu, Haochen Wang, Kuan Gao, Yuhao Wang, Yikang Zhou, Zhongwei Ren, Jacky Mai, Anna Wang, Yanwei Li, Jason Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang

entry.summary: MotionAtlas is a system for detailed region-aware motion captioning of videos, comprising a human-annotated benchmark (2,073 MCQs), a scalable training pipeline, and a family of Video-MLLMs. Given a video and spatiotemporal mask, it describes motion within the target region to reduce clutter and entanglement.

entry.title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature

author.name: Subham Ghosh, Shubham Tiwari, Mohammad Ibrahim, Abhishek Tewari

entry.summary: MatMMExtract is an open-source pipeline that decomposes compound scientific figures into sub-panels and generates grounded annotations, producing MatSciFig, a dataset of 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from materials science literature. It unlocks the visual record of materials science for AI at scale.

entry.title: IREU: Identity-Related Encoder-Only Unlearning for Customized Portrait Generation

author.name: Chaoyi Shi, Shanshan Zhang, Jian Yang

entry.summary: IREU studies identity unlearning in customized portrait generation to address privacy risks, proposing an encoder-only baseline that minimizes identity similarity for target identities while preserving others. It establishes a first approach for selectively suppressing a generator's ability to depict a specific person.

entry.title: Rigel: Self-Distilled Score Adaptation for Image and Video Captioning Evaluation

author.name: Shuitsu Koyama, Kazuki Matsuda, Yuiga Wada, Shinnosuke Hirano, Daichi Yashima, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: Rigel is an automatic evaluation metric for image and video captioning using self-distilled score adaptation, employing an evaluation-specific scoring head distilled from a frozen LLM. It addresses the mismatch between large-vocabulary language modeling and small-label-set evaluation in LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.

entry.title: DrivenMorph: Bridging Attention Mechanism and Variational Image Registration via Difference Modeling

author.name: Mingke Li, Jianping Zhang, Jinqiu Deng

entry.summary: DrivenMorph bridges attention mechanisms with variational medical image registration via difference modeling, computing a Demons-inspired driving force from local feature differences to provide explicit semantic guidance. A neural Demons layer simulates force-displacement interactions for smooth, anatomically consistent deformation.

entry.title: Efficient RGB-T Object Detection via Sparse Cross-Modality Fusion

author.name: Chao Tian, Zikun Zhou, Chao Yang, Guoqing Zhu, Zhenyu He

entry.summary: Proposes a sparse cross-modality fusion mechanism for efficient RGB-thermal object detection, first scanning images to identify proposals then fusing features only for sparse remaining proposals, avoiding heavy dual backbones and exhaustive whole-image fusion. This reduces computational cost while preserving robustness.

entry.title: SADL: What to Ignore? A Benchmark for Subject-Aware Distractor Localization

author.name: Cao-Tri Nguyen, Nguyen-Khoa Luong, Vinh-Tiep Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran

entry.summary: SADL formalizes subject-aware distractor localization, identifying which objects to remove from photos while retaining compositionally essential elements, adapting to user intent unlike saliency models or open-vocabulary detectors. It introduces a benchmark for this editing-oriented task.

entry.title: Cross-Resolution Semantic Transfer for Robust Text-to-Image Retrieval in Low-Resolution Surveillance

author.name: Wenjie Qian, Bin Yang, Xiao Wang, Wenke Huang, Ling Mei, Xin Xu, Mang Ye

entry.summary: CRST is a CLIP-style framework for cross-resolution text-to-image person re-identification in low-resolution surveillance, addressing evidence reliability collapse and ranking distribution drift through resolution-conditioned reasoning and text-guided refinement. It targets real-world resolution variance overlooked by existing methods.

entry.title: SA-VLA: State-aware tokenizer for improving Vision-Language-Action Models' performance

author.name: Tengyue Jiang, Chunpu Xu, Jiayue Kang, Yao Mu

entry.summary: SA-VLA introduces a state-aware action tokenizer that conditions discrete action decoding on robot proprioceptive state, addressing the limitation that the same token may require different continuous controls under different joint configurations and contact conditions. It studies cross-attention and other state-injection mechanisms for VQ-based tokenization.

entry.title: HUMEMBR: Learning Human Routines for Predictive Embodied Navigation

author.name: Samira Huber, Klaas Pelzer, Duc M. Nguyen, Xuesu Xiao, S\"oren Pirk

entry.summary: HUMEMBR is a human-centered memory system for embodied robots that learns long-term human routines to support embodied question answering and routine-conditioned navigation, integrating continuous memory construction with parallel retrieval. It enables reasoning over extended observation histories to predict where and when people will be.

entry.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents

author.name: Qitai Tan, Zefang Zong, Yang Li, Peng Chen

entry.summary: ATOD proposes annealed turn-aware on-policy distillation, a hybrid algorithm blending fast imitation distillation with reward-driven RL for training small multi-turn agents. Exploits complementarity between OPD's early efficiency and RL's higher ceiling.

entry.title: Towards Evaluation of Implicit Software World Models in Coding LLMs

author.name: Egor Bogomolov, Yaroslav Zharov

entry.summary: Proposes evaluating coding LLMs' implicit software world models beyond control flow by predicting execution resources like peak memory, wall-clock time, and ranked profiler outputs on SWE-bench Verified tasks. Finds even frontier models perform modestly and brittly.

entry.title: DMV-Bench: Diagnosing Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents' Visual Memory with Incidental Cue Injection

author.name: Yujin Tang, Chenming Shang, Ruize Xu, Nikhil Singh

entry.summary: DMV-Bench is the first interactive benchmark for multimodal-agent visual memory, using an e-commerce catalogue with text-leakage contracts keeping discriminative signal in pixels and incidental cues to test what agents must remember from what they saw. Fills a text-centric gap in agent memory research.

entry.title: Room for Error: Large-Scale Simulation of Over-the-Air Acoustic Attacks

author.name: Andrew C. Cullen, Neil Marchant, Jiani Xie, Paul Montague, Benjamin I. P. Rubinstein

entry.summary: Introduces a high-throughput reality simulation framework for over-the-air acoustic adversarial attacks, running over 8 million evaluations to model acoustic geometry and detectability factors abstracted away by prior digital workflows. Demonstrates acoustic awareness materially changes attack risk.

entry.title: The Simulacrum: Decision-Theoretic Pretraining for Near-Optimal Time-Series Forecasting and Inference

author.name: Pablo Montero-Manso, Marcel Scharth

entry.summary: The Simulacrum introduces decision-theoretic pretraining, training neural networks on stratified simulations from a specified generative world and decision objective to approximate optimal time-series estimators with near-optimal finite-sample properties for zero-shot inference. Provides forecasts, intervals, and model selection.

entry.title: End-to-End Dynamic Sparsity for Resource-Adaptive LLM Inference

author.name: Yuhang Chen, Jinhao Duan, Ruichen Zhang, Mingfu Liang, Xiaohan Wei, Yunchen Pu, Fei Tian, Chonglin Sun, Parish Aggarwal, Frank Shyu, Luke Simon, Sandeep Pandey, Tianlong Chen, Xi Liu

entry.summary: Learning to Allocate (L2A) is an end-to-end framework for resource-adaptive LLM inference, formulating inference as a constrained allocation problem that adapts to dynamic cloud conditions like spot-instance preemption and tiered QoS. Goes beyond input-difficulty-based dynamic sparsity.

entry.title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?

author.name: Guoheng Sun, Kaixi Feng, Shwai He, Xiaochuan Gong, Yexiao He, Ziyao Wang, Zheyu Shen, Wanghao Ye, Ramana Rao Kompella, Gaowen Liu, Ang Li

entry.summary: Studies architectural redundancy in Vision-Language-Action models via transformer block removal, introducing Drop-Then-Recovery to test whether removed capacity was necessary for robotic control. Questions how much of the oversized inherited language backbone is actually needed for short robotic instructions.

entry.title: Towards Improved Anomaly Detection for Cloud Cybersecurity via Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Manu Nandan, TJ Jaymes, Michael Brautbar, Edward Raff

entry.summary: An industrial case study applying self-supervised graph neural networks to AWS CloudTrail logs to surface suspicious cloud security events. The model produces anomaly scores and adapts dynamically without periodic retraining.

entry.title: A Mathematical Optimization Approach for Expert-Informed Bayesian Best Subset Selection

author.name: Nolan Alexander, Henning Mortveit

entry.summary: EBBS incorporates domain-expert probability estimates of feature relevance directly into the mixed-integer-optimization best-subset selection objective. It bridges classical sparse model selection with Bayesian expert priors for interpretable variable selection.

entry.title: Does Role Specialization Matter for Explanation Faithfulness in Mixture-of-Experts?

author.name: Yeji Kim, Housam Babiker, Mi-Young Kim, Randy Goebel

entry.summary: Investigates whether assigning semantic roles to Mixture-of-Experts components preserves explanation faithfulness, hypothesizing that inter-expert representation overlap degrades attribution. It introduces decorrelation regularization to reduce expert similarity and improve faithful role separation.

entry.title: T3R: Deeper Test-Time Adaptation for Graph Neural Networks via Gradient Rotation

author.name: Huy Truong, Alexander Lazovik, Victoria Degeler

entry.summary: Proposes T3R, a deeper test-time training method for graph neural networks under distribution shift, using multiple Rotograd matrices to improve task affinity between target and auxiliary tasks and a rotation technique to reorient self-supervised signals. It moves beyond shallow parameter updates in test-time training.

entry.title: Characterizing Optimizer-Dependent Training Dynamics Through Hessian Eigenvector Displacement and Localization

author.name: Marcelina Marjankowska, Valerio Modugno, Paolo Barucca

entry.summary: Studies how leading Hessian eigenvectors evolve during neural network training and how this depends on the optimizer, using displacement-over-time (from glassy-system analyses) and inverse-participation-ratio localization metrics compared against a random null model. It connects eigenvector dynamics to learning trajectories.

entry.title: Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion for Unsupervised Community Detection on Heterophilic Graphs

author.name: Feifan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion, a fully unsupervised community-detection method for heterophilic graphs using discrete Forman-Ricci edge curvature as a single topological signal propagated through a sheaf-diffusion encoder trained with label-free structural losses. It targets the hard case where connected nodes belong to different classes.

entry.title: Event-Conditioned Diagnostics of Kinematic, Contact, and Object-Permanence Fields in Passive Object-State World Models

author.name: Yang Liu, Yuming Chen

entry.summary: This paper introduces a controlled diagnostic protocol to study how passive object-state world models internally encode event-regime information, whether event contexts reweight physical field readouts, and whether field-aligned components affect prediction. It evaluates recurrent, attention, and state-space models on free-motion, collision, and occlusion events.

entry.title: Envisage: Diffusion-Based Rhinoplasty Goal Visualization with Mask-Decomposed Evaluation

author.name: Mudit Agarwal, Amit D. Bhrany

entry.summary: Envisage is a FLUX.1-Fill inpainting pipeline for rhinoplasty goal visualization from a single frontal photo, with clinical presets and hard-mask compositing. It introduces SurgicalScore, a mask-decomposed evaluation protocol since full-image identity metrics are confounded by copied pixels under composited edits.

entry.title: Adaptive Iterative Hard Thresholding for Online High-dimensional Quantile Regression

author.name: Zitian Zhou, Nan Lin

entry.summary: AIHT is an online sparse-regression framework alternating stochastic subgradient updates with adaptively scheduled hard-thresholding steps, separating support discovery from local refinement. Theory is developed for the challenging non-smooth setting of high-dimensional online quantile regression.

entry.title: Perspectives on Latent Factor Indeterminacy and its Implications for Data Representation

author.name: Carel F. W. Peeters

entry.summary: This perspective paper examines latent factor indeterminacy in factor analysis, relating it to Helmholtz/Boltzmann machines and linear autoencoders as a minimal generative representation learner. It argues that even under known dimension and resolved rotational indeterminacy, retrieval of causative latent sources remains fundamentally uncertain.

entry.title: Self-Organized Conformal Prediction: Reducing Regional Coverage Gaps with Unsupervised Group Discovery

author.name: Louis Berthier, Ahmed Shokry, Maxime Moreaud, Guillaume Ramelet, Aymeric Dieuleveut

entry.summary: Self-Organized Conformal Prediction discovers input-space groups via a Self-Organizing Map and draws local calibration buffers from the query's matching cell to reduce regional coverage gaps that pooled calibration masks. It provides validity guarantees for both regression and classification. It matters for safety-critical subgroup coverage in uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Lie Group Diffusion Models for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Synthesis

author.name: Jyotirmai Singh

entry.summary: This work uses Lie-group diffusion models for hardware-aware quantum circuit synthesis, combining a discrete circuit-skeleton selector with a diffusion model that generates single-qubit gates on the SU(2) manifold. It respects both gate geometry and hardware constraints. It matters for compiling quantum circuits to physical hardware.

entry.title: SABER-Math: Automated Benchmark for Information Retrieval Evaluation in Mathematics

author.name: Nikolay Georgiev, Maria Drencheva, Kseniia Ibragimova, Ivo Petrov, Dimitar I. Dimitrov, Martin Vechev

entry.summary: SABER-Math is the first fully automated benchmark for evaluating mathematical information retrieval without expert annotation, building challenging reranking tasks from 283K high-school math problems. It captures fine-grained mathematical relevance that prior benchmarks miss. It matters for selecting retrievers in agentic mathematical reasoning systems.

entry.title: Exploration and Online Transfer with Behavioral Foundation Models

author.name: Louis Bagot (SyCoSMA), Mathieu Lefort (LIRIS, SyCoSMA, IRISA, MALT, UR), La\"etitia Matignon (SyCoSMA)

entry.summary: This work extends Behavioral Foundation Models for zero-shot RL transfer to the online setting where the reward is a black box, removing the assumption that the agent is offline informed about the task via state-reward pairs. It addresses exploration and online transfer with reward-free pretrained agents. It matters for practical zero-shot RL with unknown rewards.

entry.title: Set-Inclusive Uncertainty Modeling for Robust Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Seunghun Baek, Jihwan Park, Jaeyoon Sim, Hoseok Lee, Seungjoo Lee, Won Hwa Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic Gaussian representation framework for brain tumor segmentation that models uncertainty from missing MRI modalities via variance regularization. It improves reliability when not all imaging modalities are available at inference.

entry.title: Open but Incompatible: A License Compatibility Analysis of Corpora for Low-Resource African Languages

author.name: Ernst van Gassen

entry.summary: Audits Creative Commons license provenance and compatibility across twenty-plus African NLP corpus families, documenting failure modes like prohibited datasets and license misrepresentation. It provides a six-tier compatibility matrix and case studies for three low-resource languages.

entry.title: SrDetection: A Self-Referential Framework for Data Leakage Detection in Code Large Language Models

author.name: Shuaimin Li, Liyang Fan, Zeyang Li, Zhuoyue Wan, Yufang Lin, Shiwen Ni, Feiteng Fang, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Yuanfeng Song, Kun Jing, Chen Jason Zhang, Min Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SrDetection, a self-referential framework to detect benchmark data leakage in code LLMs by generating semantically equivalent variants and contrasting model behavior. Works in both gray-box and black-box settings without proprietary training-corpus access.

entry.title: Are We Measuring Strategy or Phrasing? The Gap Between Surface- and Approach-Level Diversity in LLM Math Reasoning

author.name: Sangmook Lee, Minbeom Kim, Jeonghye Kim, Dohyung Kim, Sojeong Rhee, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Distinguishes surface-level phrasing diversity from approach-level strategy diversity in LLM math reasoning, showing common diversity metrics are poor proxies for genuine strategic variation. Finds approach-diverse candidate sets improve test-time scaling.

entry.title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning

author.name: Dayong Liang, Kaisong Gong, Yi Cai, Changmeng Zheng, Xiao-Yong Wei

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture of Debaters, enabling dynamic self-debate within a single model using the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm, avoiding the cost of multiple model copies in multi-agent debate. Introduces dual-routing and momentum switching to decouple role allocation from process flow for dialectical reasoning.

entry.title: Uncovering Salience-Driven Dynamics in Consumer Confidence with Generative Social Simulation

author.name: Yixu Huang, Yunlu Yin, Jiayu Lin, Xinnong Zhang, Jia Wang, Siyuan Wang, Xuanjing Huang, Liyin Jin, Zhongyu Wei

entry.summary: ConsumerSim is a generative social simulation framework that reconstructs Consumer Confidence Index dynamics from a microdata-calibrated synthetic population responding to time-stamped macroeconomic and news signals. It ranks first against persistence, time-series, and regression baselines across US, EU, and Japan series.

entry.title: CLOSER-VLN: Closed-Loop Self-Verified Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Shaoxuan Li, Xiangyu Dong, Xiaoguang Ma, Junfeng Chen, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou

entry.summary: CLOSER-VLN adds closed-loop self-verification and retrieval-augmented reasoning to aerial vision-language navigation, correcting candidate actions before execution to prevent error accumulation. It addresses the open-loop failure mode where small aerial trajectory errors compound into target loss.

entry.title: IMU-HOI: A Symbiotic Framework for Coherent Human-Object Interaction and Motion Capture via Contact-Conscious Inertial Fusion

author.name: Lizhou Lin, Songpengcheng Xia, Zengyuan Lai, Lan Sun, Jiarui Yang, Ling Pei

entry.summary: IMU-HOI jointly recovers full-body human pose and 6-DoF object trajectory from sparse body- and object-mounted IMUs, explicitly modeling human-object contacts inferred probabilistically from IMU streams. It extends inertial motion capture beyond the isolated-human assumption.

entry.title: HKVLM: Faithful Reasoning Grounding by Binding Language Queries to a Frozen Detector

author.name: Bo Ma

entry.summary: HKVLM addresses reasoning-based visual grounding by removing localization from the language path: a frozen language-aligned detector emits class-agnostic proposals while a frozen language model handles reasoning, fixing the binding failure where VLMs attend correctly but return wrong boxes. It targets faithful grounding for queries requiring reasoning rather than category matching.

entry.title: Learning from Acquisition: Metadata-driven Multimodal Pre-training for Cardiac MRI

author.name: Xueyi Fu, Liwei Hu, Zi Wang, Guang Yang

entry.summary: MetaCLIP-CMR is a metadata-driven CLIP-based framework for cardiac MRI that converts structured acquisition metadata (modality, view, vendor, field strength) into textual supervision for representation learning, exploiting weak semantic signals usually ignored by image-only models. It achieves strong modality and view classification and supports segmentation.

entry.title: Semantic-Aware, Physics-Informed, Geometry-Grounded Weather Video Synthesis

author.name: Chenghao Qian, Nedko Savov, Lingdong Kong, Yeying Jin, Rui Song, Wenjing Li, Zhun Zhong, Jiaqi Ma, Gustav Markkula, Luc Van Gool

entry.summary: This work proposes a semantic-aware, physics-informed, geometry-grounded framework that steers an off-the-shelf video editor to add diverse, controllable weather effects to videos while preserving scene identity, structure, and motion. It overcomes text-prompt underspecification and the suppression of heavy weather phenomena by general video editors.

entry.title: Efficient Spatio-Temporal Grounding with Multimodal Large Models via Second-Level Tracking and RL Verification

author.name: Tianshu Zhang, Yan Wang, Ji Qi, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: This paper proposes a spatio-temporal grounding pipeline for long videos that shifts from frame-level to second-level tracking with cross-second smoothing, synthesizes chain-of-thought trajectories with multimodal models, and uses RL verification, reducing sequence length and cost. It addresses the expense and instability of frame-by-frame VLM inference on long sequences.

entry.title: ScaleErasure: Inference-Time Minimal Intervention for Precise Concept Erasure in Next-Scale Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Cong Wang, Haiyu Wu, Zhiwei Jiang, Zifeng Cheng, Fei Shen, Yafeng Yin, Qing Gu

entry.summary: ScaleErasure is an inference-time concept-erasure method for next-scale autoregressive image generation, performing minimal intervention by guiding only the logits most relevant to unsafe concepts. It addresses semantic entanglement at early scales in this newer generative paradigm.

entry.title: RAGA: Real Time Ray Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting for 3DGS Avatar-Scene Interaction

author.name: Aymen Mir, Riza Alp Guler, Jian Wang, Peter Wonka, Bing Zhou, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: RAGA performs real-time ray-traced shadow casting for 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars entirely in Gaussian space using exact ray-Gaussian line integrals, avoiding mesh-based shadow casters. It enables physically plausible avatar-scene interaction.

entry.title: Fast Enough to Act: Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Merging for Low-Latency Robotic VLMs and VLAs

author.name: Junzhou Chen, Jindong Wang, Gang Zhou

entry.summary: ST-Merge is a training-free framework that merges redundant visual tokens during encoding for robotic VLMs and VLAs, using 3D spatiotemporal coordinates and multi-queue matching to cut inference latency. It targets real-time robot control bottlenecks from high token counts.

entry.title: NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation

author.name: Cheng Wan, Yongsen Mao, Wenzheng Wu, Yuxuan Xie, Chucheng Xiang, Runze Wang, Xiang Zhang, Zhongyuan Liu, Rushi Dai, Yuan Liu

entry.summary: NaLA is a native 3D LLM layout agent that encodes 3D scene boundaries and assets directly into the LLM rather than converting to text, preserving geometry for reasoning about collisions, support, and containment. It improves plausibility of generated 3D scene layouts.

entry.title: SonoCLIP: Mask-Guided Region-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining for Fetal Ultrasound Analysis

author.name: Hang Su, Chao Sun, Zhaofan Li, Wei Hu, Juhua Liu, Bo Du

entry.summary: SonoCLIP is presented as the first million-scale region-controllable fetal ultrasound vision-language foundation model, integrating segmentation masks as visual prompts in the encoder for joint global-local contrastive learning. It addresses CLIP's limited sensitivity to clinically decisive local structures in noisy ultrasound.

entry.title: MR-IQA: A Unified Margin View of Regression and Ranking for Blind Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Yuan Li, Youyuan Lin, Zitang Sun, Yung-Hao Yang, Kiyofumi Miyoshi, Chenhui Chu, Shin'ya Nishida

entry.summary: MR-IQA provides a unified margin view of regression and ranking for blind image quality assessment, identifying pairwise quality margin as the common bridge between the two paradigms. It shows both fit quality margins at the optimization level, clarifying their previously empirical relationship.

entry.title: SICAGE: Speaker-Independent Culture-Aware Gesture Generation using TED4C-L Dataset

author.name: Ariel Gjaci, Antonio Sgorbissa, Vittorio Murino

entry.summary: SICAGE generates culture-aware co-speech gestures conditioned on speaker-independent cultural representations, learned by treating each speaker as a domain and enforcing cross-speaker invariance. It introduces the TED4C-L dataset and evaluates under speaker-disjoint splits to avoid confounding culture with individual style.

entry.title: A Dual-domain Refinement Network with FBP-based Jacobian Learning for Sparse-view Dual-Energy CT Material Decomposition

author.name: Qian Liu, Xiaohong Fan, Ke Chen, Chong Chen, Shuaikang Wang, Jianping Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-domain refinement network with FBP-based Jacobian learning for sparse-view dual-energy CT material decomposition, explicitly incorporating the Jacobian operator of the nonlinear forward model into a deep unrolling framework. It aims to lower radiation dose while improving the ill-posed decomposition.

entry.title: LAMP: Long-Horizon Adaptive Manipulation Planning for Multi-Robot Collaboration in Cluttered Space

author.name: Shuai Zhou, Yorai Shaoul, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: LAMP is a long-horizon adaptive manipulation planner for multi-robot collaboration in dense cluttered spaces, jointly reasoning about contact formations, coupled dynamics, and collision avoidance. It targets problem scales that defeat both end-to-end RL and surrogate-planning approaches.

entry.title: TacEvo: Self-Evolving Architecture Discovery for Robotic Tactile Perception via LLM-Driven Quality-Diversity Search

author.name: Mohammed AbuSadeh, Lan Wei, Dandan Zhang

entry.summary: TacEvo is a self-evolving neural architecture discovery framework for tactile perception that uses an LLM to generate code-level mutations within a quality-diversity search, overcoming the cost and rigidity of conventional NAS. It improves designs from downstream feedback for sensor-specific tactile images.

entry.title: Grasp-Oriented Non-Prehensile Manipulation via Learning a Graspability Field

author.name: Licheng Zhong, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: Reformulates non-prehensile manipulation for grasping as optimizing an object-centric graspability field rather than reaching a predefined target pose, providing a dense reinforcement learning signal and a termination criterion for closed-loop manipulation. It accounts for objects having multiple graspable configurations.

entry.title: Learning heterogeneous treatment effects under principal stratification

author.name: Jiaqi Tong, Fan Li

entry.summary: Studies identification and estimation of conditional principal causal effects (within-stratum treatment effect heterogeneity) under principal ignorability with an odds-ratio sensitivity parameterization that relaxes monotonicity. It proposes a doubly cross-fit doubly robust machine learner for these estimands.

entry.title: AdaGrad does not adapt to H\"older-smoothness for composite objectives

author.name: Matia Bojovic, Saverio Salzo, Massimiliano Pontil

entry.summary: Exhibits a simple one-dimensional convex composite optimization problem where AdaGrad fails to achieve the classical convergence rate for Holder-smooth objectives, showing a mismatch between AdaGrad accumulation and composite optimality. It explains that non-vanishing smooth-term gradients cause AdaGrad to over-shrink its stepsize.

entry.title: MER-R1: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Slow-Fast Thinking Synergy

author.name: Zhiyuan Han, Beier Zhu, Wenwen Tong, Chengwei Qin, Xinyi Wang, Jiayu Zhang, Jiangnan Chen, Hewei Guo, Dongchuan Ran, Lewei Lu, Xun Yang

entry.summary: MER-R1 finds explicit slow reasoning does not improve multimodal emotion recognition accuracy versus fast direct answers, then proposes an RL framework that optimizes recall and precision separately to harness slow-fast complementarity. Offers a counterintuitive empirical insight.

entry.title: Verifiable Geometry Problem Solving: Solver-Driven Autoformalization and Theorem Proposing

author.name: Can Li, Ting Zhang, Junbo Zhao, Hua Huang

entry.summary: SD-GPS is a solver-driven framework for geometry problem solving that treats the symbolic solver as an execution oracle throughout autoformalization and theorem proposing, using solvability-guided RL. Addresses bottlenecks in neuro-symbolic geometry reasoning.

entry.title: SidConArena: An Environment Evaluating Agents in Open-Ended,Positive-Sum Bargaining Game

author.name: Yeqi Feng, Yuxin Chen, Tianxing He

entry.summary: SidConArena is a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in open-ended, positive-sum bargaining, formalized as a finite-horizon partially observable stochastic game with negotiation, production, and sealed-bid auction phases. Goes beyond zero-sum and static reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: Supersede: Diagnosing and Training the Memory-Update Gap in LLM Agents

author.name: Vedant Patel

entry.summary: Supersede isolates the memory-update gap in LLM agents, showing that with bounded self-maintained memory, accuracy on knowledge-update tasks drops from 92% to 77% even on a frontier model. Demonstrates the bottleneck is memory maintenance, not retrieval.

entry.title: From Signals to Transfer: A Factorised Study of Probe-Based Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models

author.name: Ponhvoan Srey, Xiaobao Wu, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Quang Minh Nguyen, Duc Anh Vu, Anh Tuan Luu

entry.summary: A factorised study of probe-based uncertainty estimation for hallucination detection in LLMs under matched conditions, disentangling feature design, training data, and evaluation. Finds raw hidden states hard to beat in-domain but structured features more robust under distribution shift.

entry.title: RGLD: Randomized Global-Local Density Estimation for Tabular Anomaly Detection

author.name: Quanling Zhao, Jiaying Yang, Ye Tian, Josh Victoria, Zhijun Wang, Pietro Mercati, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing

entry.summary: RGLD combines a global random-feature density branch with a local neighbor branch for efficient unsupervised tabular anomaly detection. It aims for accuracy and speed across heterogeneous datasets without deep-model tuning.

entry.title: Nonlinear mixture model motivated subspace clustering

author.name: Ivica Kopriva

entry.summary: Derives the linear union-of-subspaces model for subspace clustering from a nonlinear mixture model via Taylor expansion, linking smoothness order to subspace dimension and establishing bounds on subspace dimension. Connects blind source separation to subspace clustering.

entry.title: Not All Objectives Are Born Equal: Priority-Constrained Descent for Hierarchical Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Dara Varam, Mohamed I. Alhajri

entry.summary: Introduces Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD), a gradient-based optimization framework that preserves the primary objective's descent direction while permitting minimal distortion to make progress on secondary objectives, controlled by a single parameter. It addresses the symmetry problem in conventional multi-objective methods that ignore objective hierarchy.

entry.title: Learning as Observable Matrix Dynamics: Diffusive Relaxations versus Phase Transitions

author.name: Igor Halperin

entry.summary: Introduces Observable Matrix Dynamics, a diagnostic framework probing neural network training through a fixed distance matrix on held inputs, using random matrix theory and particle dynamics to reveal spectral reorganizations invisible to scalar loss. It distinguishes diffusive relaxations from phase transitions in learning.

entry.title: Improved Predictive Performance and Interpretability for Mesomorphic Neural Networks Using Local Fidelity Regularization

author.name: Hugo L. Hammer, Vajira Thambawita, Kristoffer Herland Hellton, P{\aa}l Halvorsen

entry.summary: Identifies that Interpretable Mesomorphic Neural Networks can concentrate all explanatory variance into a single weight, producing meaningless interpretations exacerbated by L1 penalties, and introduces Local Fidelity Regularization to fix this. The fix improves both predictive performance and interpretability.

entry.title: Federated Learning with Energy-Based Structured Probabilistic Inference

author.name: Dario Fenoglio, Daniil Kirilenko, Martin Gjoreski, Marc Langheinrich

entry.summary: Proposes refining federated learning client aggregation weights using Conditional Random Fields, with unary potentials for client reliability and pairwise potentials for client interactions, improving on fixed or heuristic weighting under non-IID data. CRF inference produces weights enabling better global convergence.

entry.title: ITSPACE: Monotone Gaussian Optimal Transport Updates

author.name: Woojoo Na, Jennifer Dy

entry.summary: ITSPACE is a proximal majorization-minimization method that directly optimizes the exact Bures-Wasserstein optimal transport objective on covariance matrices through closed-form square-root factorization updates. It guarantees sufficient decrease for aligning Gaussian feature distributions.

entry.title: Zero-Label Driving Scenario Complexity Detection via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture

author.name: Santosh Jaiswal

entry.summary: This work uses a minimal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture trained on structured agent-state data and its temporal prediction error as a zero-shot, label-free score for driving scenario complexity. It identifies safety-critical scenarios without any ground-truth labels.

entry.title: LoRA-Tuned Large Language Models for Dementia Detection via Multi-View Speech-Derived Features

author.name: Jonghyeon Park, Olivier Jiyoun Jung, Myungwoo Oh

entry.summary: This work fine-tunes an LLM with LoRA to perform structured multi-view reasoning over four speech-derived signals (ASR transcripts with pauses, discourse cues, fluency statistics, phonological sequences) for dementia detection. It integrates heterogeneous cognitive symptom information in a unified framework.

entry.title: Reproducing FACTER: Fairness via Conformal Thresholding and Prompt Repair

author.name: Oscar Mir\'o L\'opez-Feliu, Daimy van Loo, Xanthos Kekkos, Mikel Blom, Clara Rus

entry.summary: This is a reproducibility study of FACTER, a framework enforcing fairness and coverage in LLM recommendation via conformal thresholding and prompt repair, evaluated across architectures and sparsity levels. It identifies divergences traced to underspecified evaluation and proposes constrained re-ranking extensions.

entry.title: A Task-Driven and Quality-Assured Agent Framework for SAR Data Generation

author.name: Xuanting Wu, Fan Zhanga, Fei Ma, Ling Guan, Guochun Ma, Yongsheng Zhou

entry.summary: SAGA is a schema-grounded, benefit-aware agent framework for task-oriented SAR data generation and augmentation that handles heterogeneous dataset formats and validates generated samples. Given a natural-language request and SAR inputs, it extracts dataset facts, validates schemas, and selects feasible augmentation strategies.

entry.title: Generalization Analysis of Transformers in Distribution Regression

author.name: Peilin Liu, Ding-Xuan Zhou

entry.summary: This paper proposes a mathematical learning framework analyzing Transformer generalization in distribution regression, connecting a two-stage sampling process to NLP and providing rigorous bounds. It aims to give theoretical support to techniques like parameter-efficient fine-tuning and efficient scaling. It matters for theoretical understanding of Transformers.

entry.title: Hybrid Retriever Evolution for Multimodal Document Reasoning Agents

author.name: Bohan Yao, Shruthan Radhakrishna, Vikas Yadav

entry.summary: This work introduces a failure-driven evolution framework where a meta-agent autonomously discovers how a task agent should orchestrate diverse retrievers (lexical, semantic, multimodal) during multi-step document QA. The meta-agent diagnoses failed trajectories and rewrites the task agent. It matters for adaptive retrieval orchestration in multimodal RAG.

entry.title: CLQT: A Closed-Loop, Cost-Aware, Strategy-Consistent Benchmark for Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Portfolio-Management Agents

author.name: Bo Qu, Mingguang Chen

entry.summary: CLQT reframes closed-loop trading evaluation of LLM portfolio-management agents as diagnosis rather than return-based ranking, providing a cost-aware, strategy-consistent, temporally-gated environment that localizes where and why an agent's process succeeds or fails. It controls for look-ahead leakage. It matters for trustworthy evaluation of trading agents.

entry.title: Extrapolating from Regularised Solutions for Solving Ill-Conditioned Linear Systems in Machine Learning

author.name: Disha Hegde, Jon Cockayne, Chris. J. Oates

entry.summary: Presents an extrapolation method from Tikhonov-regularized solutions to solve ill-conditioned linear systems while preserving automatic differentiability. Useful for stable end-to-end training where nugget selection otherwise breaks gradient flow.

entry.title: Doubly Robust Adaptive Conformal Inference for Causal Effects Under Temporal Dependence

author.name: Andreas Koukorinis, Ricardo Silva

entry.summary: Proposes doubly robust adaptive conformal inference to build prediction intervals for causal effect pseudo-outcomes under temporal dependence. Abstract is very brief but addresses uncertainty quantification for causal estimands over time.

entry.title: A French OSCE Dialogue Dataset and Controllable Virtual Patient System for Clinical Training

author.name: Doria Bonzi, Tom Bourgeade, Fabrice Lef\`evre, Irina Illina

entry.summary: Introduces a French OSCE dialogue dataset of 240 student-patient interactions plus a controllable LLM pipeline for generating realistic virtual patient dialogues for medical training. It addresses scarcity of human standardized patients.

entry.title: PASTA: A Paraphrasing And Self-Training Approach for Knowledge Updating in LLMs

author.name: Takayuki Yamamoto, Daisuke Kawahara

entry.summary: PASTA is a paraphrasing-and-self-training framework that injects detailed factual news knowledge into LLMs to build specialized QA models. It combines data augmentation and question-answering generation to address knowledge updating challenges.

entry.title: Travel-Oriented Reasoning Large Language Model via Domain-Specific Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Vignesh Ram Nithin Kappagantula, Shayan Hassantabar, Samuel Simpson, Golnaz Moallem

entry.summary: Builds a travel-domain reasoning LLM grounded in an expert-designed knowledge graph, using bottom-up KG walks to generate multi-hop QA pairs for training. It addresses confident-but-unfounded outputs arising from un-internalized domain structure.

entry.title: KbSD: Knowledge Boundary aware Self-Distillation for Behavioral Calibration in Agentic Search

author.name: Tao Feng, Xinke Jiang, Chao Wu

entry.summary: Proposes KbSD, a knowledge-boundary-aware self-distillation framework for agentic search that adds dense token-level supervision and quadrant-adaptive optimization to calibrate when to trust memory, retrieve, or abstain. Targets reward sparsity in RL-based search agents.

entry.title: IHDec: Divergence-Steered Contrastive Decoding for Securing Multi-Turn Instruction Hierarchies

author.name: Nicole Geumheon Liu, Haeun Jang, Yonghyun Jun, Hwanhee Lee

entry.summary: Formalizes multi-turn instruction-hierarchy failures via Jensen-Shannon divergence, uncovering a role-influence inversion where subordinate inputs override superior roles. Proposes IHDec, a training-free contrastive decoding method to detect and correct token-level hierarchy violations.

entry.title: How Do LLMs Cite? A Mechanistic Interpretation of Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Ian van Dort (University of Amsterdam), Maria Heuss (University of Amsterdam)

entry.summary: Provides a mechanistic account of how Llama-3.1-8B decides whether to attach inline citations in RAG, using activation patching on the PopQA dataset. Maps the underlying circuit responsible for citation behavior to test whether citations faithfully reflect source use.

entry.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation

author.name: Songjun Tu, Chengdong Xu, Qichao Zhang, Yiwen Ma, Yaocheng Zhang, Linjing Li, Dong Li, Xiangyuan Lan, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces UCOB, a credit-aware on-policy bidirectional self-distillation framework for agentic RL that treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two context views of the same model and distills from whichever yields higher return. Relaxes the fragile privileged-teacher assumption when retrieved skills sometimes mislead.

entry.title: Mandol: An Agglomerative Agent Memory System for Long-Term Conversations

author.name: Yuhan Zhang (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Zhiyuan Guo (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Ziheng Zeng (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Wei Wang (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Wentao Wu (Microsoft Research), Lijie Xu (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences)

entry.summary: Mandol is a unified agglomerative memory system for long-term conversational agents that consolidates fragmented vector and graph memory into a single memory-native architecture to reduce cross-database latency and retrieval noise. It targets accuracy and efficiency in cross-session memory.

entry.title: DiffRGD: An Inference-Time Diffusion Guidance Through Riemannian Gradient Descent

author.name: Jia-Wei Liao, Li-Xuan Peng, Mei-Heng Yueh, Min Sun, Cheng-Fu Chou, Jun-Cheng Chen

entry.summary: DiffRGD is an inference-time diffusion guidance method that formulates each sampling step as constrained optimization on a spherical manifold via Riemannian gradient descent to preserve the latent Gaussian structure and avoid distributional drift. It improves controllable generation without retraining.

entry.title: BackTranslation2.0 -- A Linguistically Motivated Metric to Assess Sign Language Production

author.name: Oliver Cory, Maksym Ivashechkin, Karahan Sahin, Oline Ranum, Jianhe Low, Edward Fish, Anton Pelykh, Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan, Richard Bowden

entry.summary: BackTranslation2.0 is a linguistically grounded, agentic evaluation metric for text-to-sign translation that assesses grammatical correctness, phonological accuracy, motion fluency, and generation fidelity using specialized tools and LLM-based cross-referential comparison. It improves alignment with human judgement over naive backtranslation.

entry.title: Self-Evolving Agentic Image Restoration via Deliberate Planning and Intuitive Execution

author.name: Shuang Cui, Fan Ji, Guanglong Sun, Yufei Guo, Xiongxin Tang, Jiangmeng Li, Fanjiang Xu

entry.summary: SEAR is a self-evolving agentic image restoration framework formulating restoration as sequential decision-making with an Intuitive Executor (fast thinking) and Deliberate Planner (slow thinking) inspired by dual-process theory, to overcome greedy search and episodic amnesia in prior agentic IR. It improves exploration-exploitation balance and information reuse.

entry.title: Articulating then Matching: Zero-Shot Shape Matching for Uncurated Data

author.name: Qilong Liu, Qinfeng Xiao, Chenyuan Yi, Liying Zhang, Kit-lun Yick

entry.summary: ATM is a zero-shot 3D shape-matching framework that handles uncurated, high-resolution data with topological distortions using an articulate-then-match paradigm and pretrained vision foundation models plus parametric shape priors. It requires no correspondence-specific training.

entry.title: Pointer-CAD v2: Plan-Then-Construct CAD Generation with Dimension-Aware Parametric Precision

author.name: Dacheng Qi, Chenyu Wang, Jingwei Xu, Yi Ma, Shenghua Gao

entry.summary: Pointer-CAD v2 is a plan-then-construct CAD generation approach that emphasizes precise geometric parameters and correct metric scale rather than just visual similarity. It addresses industrial tolerance requirements that prior autoregressive, quantized methods violate.

entry.title: SAFE-DiT: Semantics-Aware Fast-path Execution for High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Xuanhua Yin, Yuxuan Jia, Chuanzhi Xu, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: SAFE-DiT is a training-free framework that accelerates high-resolution Diffusion Transformer inference by identifying and removing only provenance-certified attention masks that cause a systems bottleneck (Mask-Induced Dispatch Tax) preventing FlashAttention fast paths. It separates exact mask elision from approximate spatial scheduling.

entry.title: L2D2-GS: Learning to Densify for Feedforward Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Zetian Song, Chenming Wu, Junnan Liu, Chitian Sun, Liangliang He, Hangjun Ye, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, Wen Gao

entry.summary: L2D2-GS reformulates generalizable dynamic scene reconstruction as an iterative optimization and densification process rather than one-shot regression, for feed-forward dynamic Gaussian reconstruction of urban environments. It addresses memory limits and multi-view fusion bottlenecks for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Event-VLA: Action-Conditioned Event Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Jiaxin Liu, Xun Xu, Zhenhao Zhang, Hanqing Wang, Ruiqi Chen, Shi Chang, Weiyu Guo, Laurent Kneip

entry.summary: Event-VLA fuses action-conditioned event-camera streams with RGB to make vision-language-action models robust to illumination shifts and degraded visibility for robotic manipulation. It treats degraded-visibility manipulation as a robustness problem for RGB-centric policies.

entry.title: GarmentZoom: Generating Zoomable Images from Garment Listings

author.name: Renjie Zhao, Jingwei Ma, Huy Huynh Cao, Brian Curless, Steven M. Seitz, Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman

entry.summary: GarmentZoom enhances full-view garment photos to match the fidelity of accompanying close-ups for seamless zoom-and-pan exploration, handling spatially unaligned references and large scale factors (3-20x) without per-instance fine-tuning. It addresses limitations of standard reference-based super-resolution.

entry.title: PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution

author.name: Zhengyuan Li, Zeyun Deng, Yifan Shen, Liangyan Gui, Miaolan Xie, Joseph Campbell, Xifeng Gao, Kui Wu, Zherong Pan, Aniket Bera

entry.summary: PoseShield is a neural collision constraint defined directly in SMPL pose space, formulating self-collision correction as constrained optimization connected to the Eikonal equation for stable gradients near collision boundaries. It resolves self-penetrations in pose estimation and motion generation more robustly than mesh-space or heuristic penalties.

entry.title: UniTriSplat: A Unified 3D Gaussian Splatting Framework with Uniform Spherical Rasterization for Universal Cameras

author.name: Yipeng Zhu, Huajian Huang, Tristan Braud, Sai-Kit Yeung

entry.summary: UniTriSplat is a unified 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for universal cameras that reformulates splatting on the unit sphere via HEALPix discretization, exploiting its equal-area property for consistent solid-angle sampling across perspective, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. It derives spherical forward rendering and gradient propagation.

entry.title: Learning Cross-view Correspondences for Geo-localization on Planetary Surfaces

author.name: Hong Minh Nguyen, Marcus M\"artens, Tat-Jun Chin

entry.summary: This work introduces a cross-view geo-localization benchmark for planetary surfaces using physically rendered lunar panoramas and overhead tiles, plus methods to align ground and orbital imagery without GPS. It addresses navigation challenges for planetary exploration where satellite positioning is unavailable.

entry.title: Clinical Risk-Aware Multi-Level Grading for Coronary Artery Stenosis through Curved Feature Reconstruction

author.name: Shishuang Zhao, Hongtai Li, Junjie Hou, Yuhang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a clinical risk-aware multi-level grading model for coronary artery stenosis using a Curved Feature Reconstruction module to handle tortuous vessel paths in CCTA and 3D SCPR images. It incorporates the varying clinical risk associated with different stenosis grades into the algorithm.

entry.title: Semantic-Driven Scale and Spatial Selection for Efficient Cross-Modal Alignment in Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation

author.name: Kun Li, Shengxi Gui, Francesco Nex, Michael Ying Yang

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-driven scale and spatial selection for parameter-efficient cross-modal alignment in referring remote sensing image segmentation, avoiding full fine-tuning that can distort pre-trained features. It extends parameter-efficient tuning to capture cross-modal interactions.

entry.title: SA-Homo: Scale Adaptive Homography Estimation for Scale Variation Scenarios

author.name: Shangxuan Xie, Haifeng Wu, Yuhang Wang, Huarong Jia, Wen Li

entry.summary: SA-Homo is a scale-adaptive homography estimation framework for scenarios with large scale discrepancies between image pairs, using a hierarchical strategy transitioning from global heavy modules to local lightweight ones. It addresses degradation of existing methods under large scale gaps.

entry.title: When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning

author.name: Zhengqi Pei, Qingming Huang, Shuhui Wang

entry.summary: CLSR is a test-time framework where multiple LLM agents autonomously invent and evolve compact Language Symbolism Frameworks (symbolic protocols), and a router composes them per query to optimize the accuracy-token trade-off in multi-agent reasoning. It replaces verbose natural-language chain-of-thought with efficient symbolic communication.

entry.title: Physics Models for Sim-to-Real Transfer in Professional-Level Robot Table Tennis

author.name: Christian Conti (Sony AI, Tokyo, Japan), Bilan Yang (Sony AI, Tokyo, Japan), Alexander Sigrist (Sony AI, Zurich, Switzerland), Lorenzo Miele (Sony AI, Zurich, Switzerland), Yamen Saraiji (Sony AI, Tokyo, Japan), Peter D\"urr (Sony AI, Zurich, Switzerland), Naoya Takahashi (Sony AI, Zurich, Switzerland)

entry.summary: This Sony AI paper develops higher-fidelity physics models for sim-to-real transfer in professional-level robot table tennis, capturing the complex counterintuitive trajectories of fast, spinning balls across a wide velocity/spin range where prior work failed. Faithful simulation is critical because adversarial play exploits any sim-to-real modeling gap.

entry.title: MyGO-Splat: Multi-Objective Closed-Loop Geometric Feedback for RGB-Only Gaussian SLAM

author.name: Fan Zhu, Ziyu Chen, Zhenjun Zhao, Zhisong Xu, Hui Zhu, Mingrui Li, Chunmao Jiang, Javier Civera

entry.summary: MyGO-Splat is a closed-loop RGB-only Gaussian Splatting SLAM that rasterizes Gaussians into pixel-wise depth and normals so the map actively supervises camera pose optimization, addressing scale ambiguity and drift. It introduces scale-aware adaptive alignment using foundation-model depth.

entry.title: OpenSPM: An Environment-Transferable Robotic Key Spatial Pose Memory and Closed-Loop High-Frequency Flow-Matching Action Generation Model

author.name: Iok Tong Lei, Qingchen Xie, Yifan Wang, Yap Ying Jie, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: RoamFlow is a generative image-goal navigation framework using MeanFlow to predict an average velocity field for efficient few-step trajectory synthesis, with a two-stage training combining imitation initialization and reinforcement learning refinement. It addresses long-horizon dependency modeling and inference latency.

entry.title: KYON: Semi-Modular Wheel-Legged Quadruped With Agile Bimanual Capability

author.name: Luca Rossini, Arturo Laurenzi, Francesco Ruscelli, Yifang Zhang, Giovanbattista Gravina, Lorenzo Baccelliere, Corrado Burchielli, Stefano Cordasco, Nikos Tsagarakis

entry.summary: KYON is a semi-modular hybrid wheel-legged quadruped with a bimanual upper body for loco-manipulation, featuring reconfigurable legs, base-mounted actuators to reduce distal inertia, and a whole-body control framework combined with an RL policy. Experiments demonstrate dynamic locomotion and bimanual manipulation.

entry.title: ActiveVital: Geometry-Aware Embodied Vital Signs Monitoring for Home Healthcare Robots

author.name: Yuxuan Hu, Shihao Li, Yang Xiao, Gen Li, Feng Xu, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: ActiveVital reformulates contactless vital-signs monitoring for home robots from passive signal recovery to active geometric regulation, addressing the mmWave radar limitation that only radial motion is observable and arbitrary robot-human orientations cause angular misalignment. It actively positions the robot for stable respiration and heart-rate estimation.

entry.title: Multi-Source Transfer Learning of Sparse Single-Index Models

author.name: Ye Tian

entry.summary: Proposes a source-data-free transfer learning framework for sparse single-index models that transfers only summary statistics derived from a generalized Stein's lemma in one-time communication, preserving privacy and avoiding raw-data access while not assuming a known link function. It moves beyond constraints of existing (generalized) linear transfer methods.

entry.title: Role confusion: sounding like the cause is indistinguishable from being it.

author.name: Owain Mogford

entry.summary: A replication study of the 2026 Prompt Injection as Role Confusion paper, reproducing the direction (but not magnitude) of its results on a single GPU and applying activation steering and patching to test causal claims. The author reports an honest negative result: neither tool settles whether role confusion is the mechanism, with two clues leaning toward it being a bystander.

entry.title: DataStates-LLM: Scalable Checkpointing for Transformer Models Using Composable State Providers

author.name: Avinash Maurya, M. Mustafa Rafique, Franck Cappello, Bogdan Nicolae

entry.summary: DataStates-LLM is a scalable checkpointing system for trillion-parameter transformers using composable state providers that handle the 3D heterogeneity of distributed model state, rather than treating state as opaque blobs. Improves resilience and suspend-resume.

entry.title: Large Language Model Teaches Visual Students: Cross-Modality Transfer of Fine-Grained Conceptual Knowledge

author.name: Thomas Shih-Chao Liang, Zhuoran Yu, Yong Jae Lee

entry.summary: LaViD transfers conceptual knowledge from a language-only LLM teacher to a vision-only student by prompting the LLM to generate multiple-choice questions probing semantic class distinctions, forming soft-label conceptual signatures without paired multimodal data. Cross-modal distillation without paired data.

entry.title: PEBS: Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage for RLHF Reward-Model Calibration

author.name: Arnav Raj

entry.summary: PEBS is a per-rater empirical-Bayes shrinkage estimator that fits per-annotator affine calibrators for RLHF reward models, replacing the single global calibrator that collapses systematically different raters. Reduces within-user RMSE by ~8.6% without retraining.

entry.title: Class-frequency Guided Noise Schedule for Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiequan Cui, Beier Zhu, Qingshan Xu, Xiaojuan Qi, Bei Yu, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: First study correlating class frequency with multi-scale noise schedules in diffusion models, showing low-frequency classes face larger low-density regions and worse score estimation while high-frequency classes dominate the score space. Proposes a class-frequency guided noise schedule.

entry.title: MOSAIC: Orchestrating Collaborative Knowledge Tracing with Hierarchical Semantic Alignment

author.name: Xinjin Li, Mengyue Wang, Yuzhen Lin, Pengbin Feng, Ziqi Sha, Yeyang Zhou, Yu Ma

entry.summary: MOSAIC orchestrates LLM-driven semantic alignment with sequential modeling for collaborative knowledge tracing, using a frozen LLM for context-aware embeddings and hierarchical prompts. It captures peer interactions and multi-granularity mastery.

entry.title: Structured Proper Loss Geometries for Multiclass Classification: Theory and Controlled Empirical Evaluation

author.name: Soumyadip Sarkar

entry.summary: Studies three structured proper scoring objectives for multiclass classification (a class-aware quadratic Bregman score, a strongly convex generator, and an annealed margin-penalized variant), deriving curvature, regret, and gradient bounds. Provides controlled empirical evaluation across several datasets.
