entry.title: Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Linear-Quadratic Stackelberg Differential Games in Regime-Switching Diffusion Models

author.name: Congde Hu, Danping Li, Lin Xu, Wenying Xu

entry.summary: Companion work proposing entropy-regularized RL for linear-quadratic Stackelberg differential games in regime-switching diffusion models. Derives exploratory weakly-coupled HJBI equations enabling stochastic policies that avoid suboptimal equilibria.

entry.title: Hybrid Active-Online Learning Framework for Label-Efficient Concept Drift Adaptation in Optical Network Failure Detection

author.name: Yousuf Moiz Ali, Jaroslaw E. Prilepsky, Jo\~ao Pedro, Sasipim Srivallapanondh, Antonio Napoli, Sergei K. Turitsyn, Pedro Freire

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid active-online learning framework for label-efficient concept drift adaptation in optical network failure detection, using margin-based selective labeling to reach near-ceiling accuracy and AUC while querying only 3.4% of streaming samples. It adds negligible latency over static inference.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Software Vulnerability Analysis: A Systematic Review with Emphasis on C/C++ Source Code and Static Analysis

author.name: Bruno Caro-V\'asquez, Carola Figueroa-Flores, Gast\'on Marquez

entry.summary: This is a PRISMA-guided systematic review of reinforcement learning techniques for software vulnerability analysis, focused on C/C++ source code and static analysis, covering 21 primary studies from 2015 to 2026. It surveys tasks, algorithms, and state-action-reward formulations.

entry.title: FinInvest-GTCN: Explainable Graph-Temporal-Causal Modeling for Risk-Aware Investment Decision Optimization

author.name: Junyan Tan, Yifan Li, Minghao Wang, Zihan Chen, Haoyu Zhang

entry.summary: FinInvest-GTCN is a graph-temporal-causal network for venture capital investment decisions that combines a relational graph encoder, multi-scale temporal fusion, and a causal decision head producing risk-adjusted, interpretable predictions. It reframes the task from recommendation to quantitative risk-return assessment.

entry.title: Dynamic Parsing and Updating Natural Language Specification using VLMs for Robust Vision-Language Tracking

author.name: Xiao Wang, Liye Jin, Dan Xu, Yuehang Li, Lan Chen, Yaowei Wang, Yonghong Tian, Jin Tang

entry.summary: This work uses VLMs to dynamically parse and update natural-language target specifications during vision-language tracking, addressing semantic-visual mismatch from appearance changes. It tackles errors like hallucination and background distraction that plague LLM-generated descriptions. It matters for robust language-guided object tracking.

entry.title: ARMOR: Adaptive Retriever Optimization for Low-Resource Telecom Question Answering

author.name: Heshan Fernando, Quan Xiao, Yan Xin, Tianyi Chen

entry.summary: ARMOR adapts the retriever rather than fine-tuning the generator for low-resource telecom QA, arguing query-side retriever adaptation avoids the over-specialization that degrades generator general capability. It investigates which retriever objectives best support a fixed-generator RAG system. It matters for domain-specific RAG in technical fields.

entry.title: A Hybrid Framework For Crypto-Ransomware Detection In Enterprise Shared Storage

author.name: Gervais Hatungimana, Abdun Naser Mahmood, Mohammad Jabed Morshed Chowdhury

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid crypto-ransomware detection framework that monitors both file servers and clients to catch attacks that encrypt shared storage without triggering server-side behavioral changes. It expands detection coverage beyond endpoint-focused approaches.

entry.title: DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information

author.name: Roland Roller, Vera Czehmann, Derya Erman, Luke Flanagan, Ibrahim Baroud, Fr\'ed\'eric Blain, Viviana Cotik, Eletta Giusto, Akhil Juneja, Mariana Neves, Maria S{\l}owi\'nska, Christine Hovhannisyan, Aaron Louis Eidt, Lisa Raithel, Sebastian M\"oller, Maija Poikela

entry.summary: Releases DialogPII, a multilingual dataset of synthetic dialogs and speech-derived transcripts across eight interaction scenarios for detecting personally identifiable and sensitive information. Supports development of de-identification systems for privacy-preserving data sharing.

entry.title: The Interference Gap: Comparing Retrieval Bounds in Human Memory and RAG Systems

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu-Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Applies a unified signal-detection-theory framework to compare retrieval interference in human episodic memory versus RAG systems under semantic fan effects. Finds humans have lower interference sensitivity than dense retrieval, with cognitively-inspired HippoRAG falling between.

entry.title: RSGPNet: Geometric Prompting for Remote Sensing Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Shanwen Wang, Xin Sun, Sirui Wang, Xiao Xiang Zhu

entry.summary: RSGPNet is a training-free geometric prompting framework for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation in remote sensing, using coarse mask generation, geometric re-prompting, and coarse-to-fine consistency verification to stabilize segmentation. It addresses unstable local segmentation from CLIP-attention-based methods in the RS domain.

entry.title: ExACT: Exemplar-Driven Calibrated Refinement for Training-Free Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Zixiao Zhang, Lingling Li, Pei He, Xu Liu, Licheng Jiao

entry.summary: ExACT is a training-free framework for visual grounding in remote sensing images using a one-shot exemplar-driven visual prompting mechanism to provide discriminative structural guidance and calibrated refinement, bridging the modality gap that causes localization drift in cluttered scenes. It improves pixel-level localization without training.

entry.title: Adaptive Spectrum-Aware Feature Disentangled Network for Small Object Detection

author.name: Yang Guo, Zihan Yang, Feifei Kou, Yulan Hu, Ran Zhang, Siyuan Yao

entry.summary: SFDNet is a small object detection framework using an Adaptive Spectrum Disentanglement module to decompose backbone features into complementary spectral components, discarding background distractors in different frequency bands to build discriminative object-relevant representations. It targets the weak visual cues and frequency-domain distractors hindering SOD.

entry.title: CMTFormer: Marrying Transformer with Hierarchical Information Interaction for RGB-Event Object Detection

author.name: Yu Li, Yuenan Hou, Yingmei Wei, Jiangming Chen, Yanming Guo

entry.summary: CMTFormer is a transformer that hierarchically fuses RGB frames and event-camera streams for object detection, addressing heterogeneity between modalities to avoid noise amplification. It uses shallow-to-deep cross-modal interaction stages.

entry.title: DTI: Dynamic Trajectory Initialization for Generative Face Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Yingwei Tang, Chen Yan, Wendi Liu, Qiang Hu, Xiaoyun Zhang

entry.summary: DTI reformulates generative face video super-resolution as input-driven directional restoration on a pretrained DiT backbone, using enhancement-and-injection conditioning to improve fidelity without expensive auxiliary training. It addresses fixed sampling and high inference cost of diffusion-based methods.

entry.title: Again-Pose: Anchor-Guided Adaptive Inter-Frame Motion Cues Propagating for High-quality Human Pose Reconstruction

author.name: Shuaikang Zhu, Yiding Sun, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Again-Pose reconstructs 3D human poses from videos with severe motion blur and occlusion by propagating anchor-guided inter-frame motion cues instead of relying on fragile implicit temporal attention. It targets feature collapse under visual degradation.

entry.title: D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR: Degradation-Disentangled Representation for Real-World Omnidirectional Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Hongyu An, Xinfeng Zhang, Xu Fan, Shijie Zhao, Li Zhang, Ruiqin Xiong

entry.summary: D2R2OSR is a degradation-disentangled framework for real-world omnidirectional (360-degree) image super-resolution that accounts for fisheye capture and equirectangular projection distortions. It addresses aliasing and projection-specific artifacts that generic Real-SR methods ignore.

entry.title: MF-UAVPose6D: A Model-Free Monocular 6-DoF Pose Estimation Framework for Fixed-Wing UAVs

author.name: Juanqin Liu, Leonardo Plotegher, Eloy Roura, Shaoming He

entry.summary: MF-UAVPose6D is a model-free monocular 6-DoF pose estimation framework for fixed-wing UAVs that needs only a single RGB image and camera intrinsics, without CAD models or keypoint priors. It uses heatmap-guided center localization and a perspective-aware module for non-cooperative targets.

entry.title: Measured-Subspace Consistency: A Plug-and-Play Operator for Diffusion Posterior Sampling in Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Junhyeok Lee, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: This paper identifies measured-subspace leakage in diffusion posterior samplers for accelerated MRI, where uncertainty is wrongly placed on already-measured k-space coefficients, and proposes a training-free terminal correction (MSC) enforcing measured-subspace consistency. It also introduces MSD/USD dispersion metrics to quantify the problem.

entry.title: GROW$^2$: Grounding Which and Where for Robot Tool Use

author.name: Yuhong Deng, Yuyao Liu, David Hsu

entry.summary: GROW2 tackles open-world affordance grounding for robot tool use by splitting the problem hierarchically into semantic part selection (using VLM commonsense) and geometric region localization, enabling creative tool use beyond intended functions. It avoids data-heavy end-to-end training.

entry.title: Semantics-Aware Bilevel Co-Evolution: Towards Automated Multicomponent Algorithm Design

author.name: Zhiyao Zhang, Shenghao Wu, Xingyu Wu, Kay Chen Tan

entry.summary: This paper presents a semantics-aware bilevel co-evolution framework for LLM-assisted automated design of multicomponent algorithms, enabling reuse of high-quality components and explicit modeling of algorithm semantics. It addresses limitations of prior LLM evolutionary search that modify whole algorithms or use fixed configurations.

entry.title: RoboGaze: Evaluating Robot World Models via Structured Vision-Language Analysis

author.name: Minh-Loi Nguyen, Nghiem Tuong Diep, Hung Khang Nguyen, Minh Le, Doanh Le Thien, Hoang H. Tran, Dung D. Le, Vu N. Duong, Daniel Sonntag, An Thai Le, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Vien Anh Ngo, Tran Van Nhiem

entry.summary: RoboGaze is a training-free multi-agent VLM framework for structured, interpretable evaluation of generated robot-manipulation videos, using task-scene grounding, dimension-specific specialist routing, and critic-based verification. It outputs temporally localized glitches that conventional metrics and monolithic VLM judges miss.

entry.title: Multi-Contact Force Estimation for Continuum Robots via Gaussian-Parameterized Factor Graphs

author.name: Aditya Prakash, Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: Proposes a factor-graph framework using a Gaussian mixture force parameterization to estimate multi-contact external forces along continuum robots. The method reduces dimensionality and mitigates ill-conditioning by fusing strain, tendon tension, and pose data.

entry.title: PL-LIT: A LiDAR-Inertial-Thermal SLAM Using Point-Line Features and Thermographic Mapping

author.name: Jiawei Xia, Yixiao Feng, Yongliang Shi, Chao Gao, Renjing Xu, Weining Lu, Bin Liang

entry.summary: PL-LIT is a LiDAR-Inertial-Thermal SLAM system using point-line features and thermographic mapping designed to handle thermal imaging challenges like low contrast and automatic gain control that break brightness constancy assumptions. It works across both visible and thermal cameras.

entry.title: Lateral String Stability for Vehicle Platoons

author.name: Sixu Li, Swaroop Darbha, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: This paper develops a framework for lateral string stability in connected automated vehicle platoons, addressing how path-tracking errors propagate along a platoon, an underexplored counterpart to longitudinal stability. It focuses on safety-critical lateral deviations.

entry.title: Trajectory Optimization for Collision-Aware Redundant Robotic Multi-Axis Additive Manufacturing by Constrained Gradient Projection

author.name: Zhikai Shen, Jiasheng Qu, Chenyu Xu, Zhuo Huang, Chengkai Dai, Yongzhe Li, Guoxin Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a collision-aware trajectory optimization framework for redundant robotic multi-axis additive manufacturing using a differentiable signed-distance-field collision model and iterative projection onto the self-motion manifold to enforce deposition constraints. It handles fabrication-induced geometry evolution.

entry.title: AUSLUN: A Fixed-Hover UAV--USV System for GNSS-Denied Maritime Search and Navigation

author.name: Siyuan Yang, Zikai Jia, Hailiang Kuang, Xiaoyu He, Qizhi Guo, Yihao Dong, Shaoming He

entry.summary: AUSLUN is a fixed-hover UAV-USV system for GNSS-denied maritime search and navigation, using a coastal UAV with visual-inertial odometry as a long-range sensing and navigation anchor. It shifts sensing motion to a zoom pod and uses annular scanning and bearing-range localization to guide the surface vehicle.

entry.title: CalBrief: A Pilot Diagnostic Benchmark for Evidence-Calibrated Scientific Briefing with Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Fu, Yongqi Kang, Yong Zhao

entry.summary: CalBrief is a pilot diagnostic benchmark testing whether LLMs can calibrate scientific takeaways to evidence strength, scope, and missing-evidence caveats across 16 evidence packages with human-verified takeaways. Probes evidence-calibrated briefing failures.

entry.title: Global Explanations for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Models via $K$-Order Markov Approximations

author.name: Amadeo Tunyi

entry.summary: KARMA explains multivariate time-series forecasting models by constructing a K-order Markov surrogate that respects temporal dependencies, identifying the minimal sufficient history length and estimating the transition kernel. Addresses XAI methods that wrongly assume timestamp independence.

entry.title: Redefining Maritime Anomaly Detection via Equation-Grounded Synthetic Anomalies

author.name: Youngseok Hwang, Sungho Bae, Dohun Lee, Jaeeun Seo, Jeehong Kim, Wonhee Lee, Hyunwoo Park

entry.summary: Proposes equation-grounded synthetic anomaly generation for maritime anomaly detection from AIS data, addressing the lack of labeled anomalies and capturing interaction-driven hazards like near-miss vessel approaches. It moves beyond statistical rarity and costly expert labeling.

entry.title: Transformer-Based Active Learning for Data-Efficient Vaccine Epitope Selection in PRRS

author.name: Aspen Erlandsson Brisebois, Zahed Khatooni, Connor Burbridge, Brook Byrns, Heather L. Wilson, Sureesh Tikoo, Steven Rayan, Gordon Broderick

entry.summary: This work evaluates transformer-based active learning to classify high-affinity epitope-receptor binding for PRRS vaccine design, reducing reliance on expensive molecular docking simulations that take over 48 GPU-hours each. It compares multiple model families on an internal dataset of 80 docking affinities.

entry.title: Gradient boosting with vector-valued leafs

author.name: David Cortes

entry.summary: This work extends gradient boosting to vector-valued leaves, handling objective functions on vectors like multinomial log-likelihood without the usual one-value-at-a-time updates or diagonal Hessian bounds. It sketches an efficient histogram-based algorithm. It matters for improving multi-output gradient boosting frameworks.

entry.title: Implementation of Hyperelastic Physics-Augmented Neural Networks in the Explicit Finite Element Codes Simcenter Radioss and OpenRadioss with Applications to Impact Events

author.name: Lukas Maurer, Sascha Eisentr\"ager, Marian Bulla, Daniel Juhre

entry.summary: This work integrates pretrained physics-augmented hyperelastic neural-network material models into explicit finite-element solvers Simcenter Radioss and OpenRadioss via a standalone user-material routine, enabling impact-event simulations. It bridges PyTorch-trained PANNs with industrial FE codes. It matters for deploying ML constitutive models in engineering simulation.

entry.title: A Hybrid Framework for Song Lyric Annotation Based on Human-LLM Alignment

author.name: Rashini Liyanarachchi, Frank Tran, Md Mahmudul Hasan, Aditya Joshi, Erik Meijering

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid human-LLM framework for sentence-level song lyric emotion annotation, introducing a new dataset and predicting potential human-LLM annotation misalignment to optimize labeling. It highlights the subjectivity of lyric emotion recognition.

entry.title: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Token Co-occurrence Graphs

author.name: Gianluca Bonifazi, Christopher Buratti, Michele Marchetti, Federica Parlapiano, Giulia Quaglieri, Davide Traini, Domenico Ursino, Luca Virgili

entry.summary: Proposes TIGRAG, a graph-augmented RAG framework that builds a token co-occurrence knowledge graph from sliding-window statistics instead of expensive LLM-based extraction. Aims to enable scalable graph construction for multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Grounding LLM Reasoning under Incomplete Graph Evidence

author.name: Jiaqi Li, Fanghui Song

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical perspective on grounding LLM reasoning under incomplete, retrieved knowledge-graph evidence, showing no hard rule can both reject all false trajectories and retain all true-but-unobserved ones. Characterizes soft grounding as a KL-regularized objective.

entry.title: LLM-Ideoplasticity: Measuring Ideological Plasticity in the Political Behavior of LLMs as a Context-Conditioned Distribution

author.name: Adib Sakhawat, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Tahsin Islam, Takia Farhin, Hasan Mahmud, Md Kamrul Hasan

entry.summary: Argues an LLM's political ideology is a context-conditioned distribution rather than a fixed point, evaluating nine models via VAA-CHES projection across six contextual axes. Finds persuasive framing and under-represented languages shift coordinates substantially while the cohort clusters narrowly overall.

entry.title: Auditing LLM-Governed Social Robots with Culture-Specific Moral Gradients

author.name: Carmen Ng, Gjergji Kasneci

entry.summary: Introduces a gradient-based multilingual audit of LLM moral trade-off behavior in embodied social-robot prioritization against culture-specific preference gradients. Derives symmetry-controlled scenarios from social-robotics reviews to expose pluralistic miscalibration.

entry.title: Mitigating Batch Effects in Histopathology via Language-Mediated Robust Embedding Generation

author.name: Yishu Zhang, Shushan Wu, Zhenzhong Zhang, Didong Li, Huaxiu Yao, Yun Li, Iain Carmichael, Katherine A. Hoadley, Hongtu Zhu, Di Wu, Daiwei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents GLMP, which mitigates batch effects in pathology foundation models by generating robust numerical embeddings from histology patches through an intermediate textual representation produced by general-purpose MLLMs. Aims to reduce non-biological cross-institution variation that harms generalization.

entry.title: MedEvoEval: Evaluating Continual Evolution of Doctor Agents through Simulated Clinical Episodes

author.name: Hui Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MedEvoEval, an executable longitudinal benchmark evaluating how doctor agents evolve across simulated outpatient episodes through memory, retrieval, and reflection. Addresses limitations of fixed-input QA benchmarks for assessing cross-episode clinical decision evolution.

entry.title: EpiSAM: Character Segmentation in Challenging Stone Inscriptions

author.name: Arnav Sharma, Pratyush Jena, Amal Joseph, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla

entry.summary: EpiSAM is a prompt-guided transformer framework for character segmentation in challenging stone inscriptions, using a neighbor-aware strategy that predicts adjacent characters to resolve boundary ambiguities under erosion and low contrast. It targets robust automated epigraphic analysis where conventional document techniques fail.

entry.title: Zero-Gated Language-conditioned Human Motion Prediction

author.name: Guanhui Qiao, Lu Zhou, Ding Jiang, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: ZGL is a lightweight language-conditioned 3D human motion predictor that uses VLM-generated captions of observed motion as a semantic prior, injected via zero-gated cross-attention adapters into a DCT-based transformer. It augments motion dynamics with high-level semantic guidance.

entry.title: MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching

author.name: Zhihong Liu, Zheng Li, Jiachun Jin, Siqi Kou, Yitao Jian, Fengpei Yu, Zhijie Deng

entry.summary: MirrorPPR introduces exemplar-based portrait photo retouching, where a model infers and applies the same edits from an exemplar pair to a query image. It handles delicate localized structural facial and body changes that text guidance cannot convey.

entry.title: Bit-ViP: Leveraging Bit-planes to Preserve Visual Privacy in Images through Obfuscation

author.name: Vishesh Kumar Tanwar, Ashish Gupta, Sanjay Madria, Sajal K. Das

entry.summary: Bit-ViP is a bit-plane-based image obfuscation scheme that preserves visual privacy while keeping obfuscated images trainable and resistant to model-inversion reconstruction. It targets privacy concerns for images stored on cloud servers.

entry.title: HTC-SGA Former: A Hybrid Transformer-CNN Network with Self-Guided Attention and a New Boundary-Weighted Adaptive Loss for Coronary DSA Vessel Segmentation

author.name: Rayan Merghani Ahmed, Marwa Omer Mohammed Omer, Mohamed Elmanna, Shijie Li, Bin Li, Shoujun Zhoua

entry.summary: HTC-SGA Former is a lightweight hybrid Transformer-CNN network with self-guided attention and a boundary-weighted adaptive loss for coronary DSA vessel segmentation. It targets thin low-contrast vessels and severe class imbalance using a CNN encoder and Transformer decoder.

entry.title: UnfoldArt: Zero-Shot Recovery of Full Articulated 3D Objects from Text or Image

author.name: Mohamed el amine boudjoghra, Ivan Laptev, Angela Dai

entry.summary: UnfoldArt presents a zero-shot, debate-driven agentic approach to reconstruct full articulated 3D objects from text or image, recovering articulation, hidden geometry, and internal structure. High-level agents reason about semantics and motion using VLMs and video models while low-level components ground articulation.

entry.title: SIR: Structured Image Representations for Explainable Robot Learning

author.name: Paul Mattes, Jan Schwab, Jens Bosch, Nils Blank, Maximilian Xiling Li, Minh-Trung Tang, Moritz Haberland, Rudolf Lioutikov

entry.summary: SIR uses scene graphs as an intermediate, explicitly structured representation for robot policy learning, learning to sparsify a fully connected graph into a task-relevant sub-graph passed to action generation. This makes the policy intrinsically interpretable and more robust to visual distractions.

entry.title: Embodiment Meets Environment: Toward Context-Aware, Safe Physical Caregiving Robots

author.name: Zhanxin Wu, Ruofei Tong, Jiaying Fang, Tapomayukh Bhattacharjee

entry.summary: E2-CARE is a framework for context-aware physical caregiving robots that represents primitive caregiving skills as interaction templates whose execution is reshaped online based on the joint interaction between environment and robot embodiment. It aims to generalize across users, tasks, environments, and robot embodiments while constraining human-centered interactions.

entry.title: Empowering a Single-Frequency GNSS Receiver to Achieve High-Precision Positioning with Relative Observations

author.name: Xingpeng Wang, Ziwen Qu, Juncheng Chen, Ruitian Pang, Xiangyu Li, Tiancheng Lai, Siqi Shen, Wentao Liu, Pengfei Wang, Chao Xu, Yanjun Cao

entry.summary: Presents a tightly-coupled state estimation framework enabling low-cost single-frequency GNSS receivers to achieve high-precision localization using relative motion sensors via a sliding-window factor graph. It offers a cost-effective alternative to expensive RTK infrastructure.

entry.title: Human-Guided Agentic Research: A Research Agenda

author.name: fastfedora

entry.summary: A proposed research agenda for 'human-guided agentic research,' focused on how humans can interpret and steer autonomous research agents during recursive self-improvement, especially when agents may lack taste or attempt to reward hack, sandbag, or sabotage. It frames the problem and sketches potential solution directions. This is an agenda-setting piece for AI safety.

entry.title: When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?

author.name: Aryan Keluskar, Amrita Bhattacharjee, Huan Liu

entry.summary: Investigates whether personality trait prompting (e.g., agreeableness) of LLM agents affects objective task outcomes across coding, research collaboration, and bargaining domains. Finds personality effects are domain-dependent rather than universal.

entry.title: Deployment-Side Adaptiveness in Multi-Horizon Volatility Forecasting

author.name: Riku Green, Zahraa S. Abdallah, Telmo M Silva Filho

entry.summary: Studies deployment-side adaptiveness in multi-horizon volatility forecasting, showing a trained MIMO forecaster defines a family of predictors via different inference-time rollout rules, and non-default rules often beat standard deployment. Highlights that how a model is deployed matters as much as which model.

entry.title: Analysis of Adam Algorithms for Stochastic Dynamic Systems

author.name: Xin Zheng, Yifei Jin, Lei Guo

entry.summary: Investigates whether generative models can implicitly learn emotional body motion from culturally grounded motion-capture data without explicit emotion labels, for use in VR avatars and social robotics. Tests perception improvement of emotional expressions.

entry.title: Deciphering Region-Level Signatures from Latency Measurements in LEO Satellite Internet

author.name: Xiang Shi, Yifei Zhang, Peng Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical analytical framework converting raw Starlink RTT measurements into multi-scale statistical features to characterize region-level latency signatures in LEO satellite Internet. Uses data from five geographic regions.

entry.title: Bilevel Optimization for Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Abhishek Shukla, Ankur Sinha, Faiz Hamid

entry.summary: A structured survey framing Neural Architecture Search through the lens of bilevel optimization, categorizing NAS approaches and clarifying the outer-level architecture and inner-level weight optimization interaction. It connects NAS to broader hierarchical optimization applications.

entry.title: Transformer Architectures as Complete Bayes Processes: A Formal Proof in the Measure-Theoretic Kernel Framework

author.name: Haobo Yang

entry.summary: This paper presents a formal measure-theoretic proof that transformer architectures, under a Bayes joint-distribution condition, implement exact Bayesian posterior inference across attention, residual, and MLP pipelines. It builds a hierarchy of abstractions from core Bayesian transformers to multilayer stacks.

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Three-Axis Fidelity for Aligning LLM-Based Survey Simulators from Small Pilot Data

author.name: Eun Cheol Choi, Youngrae Kim, Prabhu Pugalenthi, Hong-En Chen, Bo-Ruei Huang

entry.summary: This paper studies whether LLMs can recover broader-population survey statistics from small pilot samples, decomposing fidelity into structural, marginal, and individual axes. It benchmarks prompting, rectification, and fine-tuning on a COVID misinformation survey, finding fine-tuning offers balanced recovery. It matters for using LLMs as survey simulators in social science.

entry.title: Harvesting AI Computation at the Edge via Generic Approximation

author.name: Yihan Wang, Huiru Yan, Luxin Zhang, Long Cheng, Weiwei Chen, Ying Wang, Lei Zhang, Cheng Liu, Huawei Li

entry.summary: This framework harvests underutilized edge AI-chip computation to perform general-purpose tasks via generic approximation, offloading compute-intensive signal processing onto specialized NN accelerators. It addresses the imbalance where AI chips sit idle while general engines struggle with heavy tasks. It matters for efficient edge computing in IoT.

entry.title: Adjusted Wasserstein distances for bridging empirical and true distributions with applications to MDS

author.name: Flor Martinez-Sermeno, Arturo Jaramillo, Johan Van Horebeek

entry.summary: This paper introduces Max-D-SW, an adjustment of the Max-Sliced Wasserstein distance that aggregates over orthonormal bases rather than single directions, improving multidimensional scaling visualizations especially for heavy-tailed distributions. It establishes sample-complexity bounds. It matters for distance-based visualization and pattern recognition.

entry.title: A multi-architecture study of specificity refinement and false-positive mechanism analysis in prostate MRI

author.name: Yongbo Shu, Kewen Chen, Yifeng Yuan, Zirui Xin, Luo Lei, Yang Yang, Xi Chen, Aijing Luo

entry.summary: This multi-architecture study characterizes residual false positives in prostate MRI lesion detection and evaluates a tiny 89k-parameter post-hoc refinement head for case-level specificity across five backbones using imaging contrast-ratio analysis. It validates externally on Prostate158. It matters for reducing false positives in clinical prostate MRI AI.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning General-Purpose Large Language Models for Agricultural Applications:A Reproducible Framework and Evaluation Protocol Based on Qwen3-8B

author.name: Zhaoyang Li, Ruijie Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Zhaoji Sun

entry.summary: AgriTune-R proposes a reproducible and auditable framework for fine-tuning general-purpose LLMs (Qwen3-8B) for agriculture, explicitly avoiding unverified performance claims and emphasizing data governance and expert evaluation. It focuses on safety and evidence constraints for a domain-critical assistant.

entry.title: Fast Numbers, Slow Language: Bridging Quantitative and Qualitative Earnings Signals

author.name: Ding Yu, Zhuo Liu, Hao Zhang, Hangfeng He

entry.summary: Bridges 50 years of financial-economics work on quantitative earnings surprise with a decade of NLP work on qualitative earnings-call language, unifying their incompatible frameworks. Studies how numeric and linguistic earnings signals arrive sequentially and affect markets.

entry.title: Are Humans Evolved Instruction Followers? An Underlying Inductive Bias Enables Rapid Instructed Task Learning

author.name: Anjishnu Kumar

entry.summary: A position paper arguing humans possess an evolved instruction-following inductive bias enabling rapid instructed task learning, analogous to how instruction tuning gives LLMs zero-shot ability. Synthesizes cognitive science and ML evidence.

entry.title: Not-quite-human tastes: the stylized omnivorousness of LLM survey surrogates

author.name: Xiangyu Ma, Mengmi Zhang, Shannon Ang, Minne Chen

entry.summary: Generates over 277,000 LLM survey surrogates per model from OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek to test silicon sampling for cultural taste. Finds LLM surrogates show a stylized omnivorousness that diverges from real human cultural-consumption patterns.

entry.title: DAIN: Dynamic Agent-Based Interaction Network for Efficient and Collaborative Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Xinxin Chen, Yuchen Li, Zihan Wang, Haoyu Zhang, Ruixin Liu, Mingyuan Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces DAIN, which reframes multimodal fusion as dynamic multi-agent collaboration with a context-aware meta-controller scheduling sparse specialized interaction agents. Jointly optimizes accuracy, agent specialization, and efficiency via a multi-objective loss.

entry.title: SIMAX: A Scalable and Interpretable Framework for Multi-Fidelity and Annotated Clinician-Patient Dialogue Simulation

author.name: Zhuhan Bao, Rui Yang, Bohao Yang, Zhiyi Liu, Sicheng Shu, Ruio Heerschap, Le Li, Doris Yang, Elisabeth Bond, Haoyuan Wang, Nicoleta Economou-Zavlanos, Joshua M. Biro, Matthew McDermott, Nan Liu, Anand Chowdhury, Kai Sun, Kathryn Pollak, Ed Hammond, Chuan Hong

entry.summary: Presents SIMAX, a framework for generating controlled, annotated clinician-patient dialogue data with reference behavioral annotations from predefined scenarios, personas, and voice conditions. Addresses the cost and scarcity of human-coded communication data for AI coding systems.

entry.title: SurrogateShield: Beyond Redaction for High-Utility, Privacy-Preserving LLM Interactions

author.name: Sherwin Vishesh Jathanna

entry.summary: SurrogateShield is a client-side proxy that swaps detected PII with locally generated type-consistent surrogate values before sending queries to third-party LLM APIs, then restores originals in responses. It aims to preserve semantic coherence better than placeholder redaction while keeping real PII off remote infrastructure.

entry.title: GeoISF: Instance Semantic Forest Inspired Large-Scale Cross-View Geo-Localization via Ground LiDAR-to-Satellite Image

author.name: Di Hu, Xia Yuan, Chunxia Zhao

entry.summary: GeoISF performs large-scale cross-view geo-localization by matching ground LiDAR point clouds to satellite imagery using an instance semantic forest built with WordNet to bridge the modality gap. It targets robust localization where prior LiDAR-to-image methods struggle at scale.

entry.title: Multi-scale Object-Aware Gaze Estimation via Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Jiajie Mi, Xinyu Liu, Mengke Song, Chenglizhao Chen

entry.summary: This work proposes a two-stage object-aware gaze target estimation framework with geometric reasoning, explicitly representing the gazed object as an entity rather than treating gaze as pixel-level regression. It aims for stable, semantically consistent predictions in complex scenes.

entry.title: UrbanCDNet: Appearance-Robust and Boundary-Aware Bitemporal Change Detection for Korean Urban Building Monitoring

author.name: Abdirashid Omar, Jonghyuk Park

entry.summary: UrbanCDNet is a task-specific Siamese CNN for bi-temporal urban building change detection in Korean aerial imagery, combining appearance-robust comparison, alignment-aware differencing, context refinement, and boundary supervision. It targets sparse changes, strong appearance variation, and building-footprint-aligned outputs on a corrected benchmark.

entry.title: HomeDiffusion: Zero-Shot Object Customization with Multi-View Representation Learning for Indoor Scenes

author.name: Guoqiu Li, Jin Song, Yiyun Fei

entry.summary: HomeDiffusion performs zero-shot object customization for indoor scenes using multi-view representation learning to preserve fine object details when placing furniture or clothing into target scenes. It targets e-commerce visualization where existing methods lose object fidelity.

entry.title: When Stopping Fails: Rethinking Minimal Risk Conditions through Human-Interactive Autonomous Driving for Safe Transportation Systems

author.name: Yash Tandon, Giovanni Tapia Lopez, Marcus Blennemann, Mohan Trivedi, Ross Greer

entry.summary: This paper analyzes publicly documented incidents where autonomous-vehicle stopping behaviors (minimal risk conditions) cause harm by obstructing traffic and emergency response, arguing that stopping alone does not ensure safe integration into human-governed roads. It rethinks MRC design for human-interactive autonomous driving.

entry.title: Distilling a Modular Reservoir Through a Genomic Bottleneck

author.name: Mani Hamidi, Sina Khajehabdollahi, Charley M. Wu, Emmanouil Giannakakis

entry.summary: This work uses hypernetworks to learn a compressed generative process (a genomic bottleneck) that distills the connectivity of a modular reservoir, inspired by how genomes encode neural structure that is refined through experience. It combines curriculum-based meta-learning with developmental encoding.

entry.title: On the Identifiability of Aided Inertial Navigation Under Measurement Delays: A Geometric Approach

author.name: Jonathan Kelly

entry.summary: This paper presents a geometric analysis of identifiability in aided inertial navigation when an aiding sensor has an unknown constant time delay relative to the IMU stream. It shows that a broader class of degenerate trajectories than previously known admits a continuous symmetry preventing unique recovery of delay and state.

entry.title: MOAR Planner: Multi-Objective and Adaptive Risk-Aware Path Planning for Infrastructure Inspection with a UAV

author.name: Louis Petit, Alexis Lussier Desbiens

entry.summary: MOAR Planner is a multi-objective adaptive risk-aware path planner for UAV infrastructure inspection that optimizes safety, time, and energy in real time using a risk-aware cost function with damage/insertion costs and adaptive speed planning. It accounts for dynamic risks like weather, communication reliability, and battery.

entry.title: Third-parties should focus on scrutinising system cards

author.name: Cleo Nardo

entry.summary: A governance-focused argument by Cleo Nardo that third-party scrutiny of AI lab system cards is a high-value activity, warning that system cards will likely degrade and outlining recommendations for external review. It connects card quality to lab incentives and risk communication. This is substantive AI governance commentary.

entry.title: Ontology-Guided Evidence Path Inference for Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Yongxue Shan, Meihan Wu, Cundi Fang, Jie Peng, Xiaodong Wang

entry.summary: OPI is an ontology-guided evidence path inference framework for multi-hop knowledge-graph QA, using a relation-centric ontology graph and bidirectional retrieval to constrain search and reduce noisy mixed-type paths. Targets complex semantic constraints.

entry.title: Benchmarking Multi-Modal Graph-based Social Media Popularity Prediction

author.name: Utkarsh Sahu, Zhisheng Qi, Li Zhu, Yizhao Yang, Jun Li, Ryan Rossi, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Benchmarks multimodal graph-based social media popularity prediction, jointly considering multimodal content and temporal social interaction signals that prior fragmented works neglect. Unifies datasets, modalities, and protocols for fair comparison.

entry.title: From General-Purpose Audio Tagging to Spatially Grounded Sound Event Localization and Detection

author.name: Stefano Giacomelli, Stefano Damiano, Claudia Rinaldi, Fabio Graziosi, Toon van Waterschoot

entry.summary: AT2SELD extends pretrained general-purpose audio tagging models to spatially grounded sound event localization and detection by coupling an AT backbone with First-Order Ambisonics spatial processing, developed via multi-stage neural architecture search. Studies how semantic audio priors aid localization under constraints.

entry.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness via Activation Amplification and Attenuation

author.name: Ta\"iga Gon\c{c}alves, Yongsong Huang, Tomo Miyazaki, Shinichiro Omachi

entry.summary: Activation Amplification and Attenuation (A3) is a lightweight plug-in module that improves adversarial robustness by jointly learning to amplify and attenuate activation signals via a learnable mask and scaling factor derived from activation magnitudes. Diverges from pruning/masking defenses.

entry.title: Position Bias Correction is Insufficient for One-Pass Attention Sorting

author.name: Qiong Tang, Xiangkun Hu, Xiangyang Liu, Yiran Chen, Yunfan Shao

entry.summary: Tests whether position-bias correction enables single-pass attention sorting for long-context models, but experiments refute the hypothesis: debiasing produces identical results to uncalibrated single-pass sorting on LLaMA-2-7B-32K. A negative result on the role of position bias.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning in Super Mario Bros: Curriculum, Pedagogy, and Optimal Level Design in World 1-1

author.name: Jesse Ponnock, Lucas Ho

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning (Q-Learning, SARSA, Monte Carlo, DQN) to empirically measure the pedagogical structure of Super Mario Bros World 1-1 as a discrete environment. Monte Carlo achieves the best win rate, and a curriculum experiment examines optimal level design.

entry.title: Comparing Chatbot Performance Enhanced with Persistent Homology

author.name: Nithisha Raghavaraju, Barbara Giunti, Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Explores enhancing chatbot performance, particularly for mental-health support with limited or private data, using persistent homology vectorizations to augment input datasets without growing the dataset. It compares chatbot performance with and without topological enhancement.

entry.title: BTI-Net: Bidirectional Decoder-Level Task Interaction via Uncertainty-Aware Gating for Multi-Task Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Abdullah Al Shafi, Md Kawsar Mahmud Khan Zunayed, Safin Ahmmed, Sk Imran Hossain, Engelbert Mephu Nguifo

entry.summary: BTI-Net introduces bidirectional decoder-level task interaction with uncertainty-aware gating to jointly perform medical image segmentation and classification, sharing boundary cues and semantic priors between branches. It overcomes the limitation of encoder-sharing architectures that discard cross-task information. It matters for multi-task medical image analysis.

entry.title: Multi-Level Distributional Entropy for Explainable Network Intrusion Detection

author.name: Mohamed Aly Bouke, Md Shohel Sayeed, Swee-Huay Heng, Azizol Abdullah, Mohamed Othman

entry.summary: MDE derives interpretable entropy features directly from pre-aggregated flow statistics at three levels for network intrusion detection, avoiding the need for raw packet sequences. It evaluates across four benchmarks under a leakage-free pipeline. It matters for explainable IDS using available flow data.

entry.title: Forewarned is Forearmed: When Non-Sequential Embedding Turns Into an Anomaly Detector

author.name: Elys Allesiardo, Antoine Caubri\`ere, Valentin Vielzeuf

entry.summary: This paper analyzes non-sequential multimodal sentence embeddings (focusing on SONAR), showing certain embedding dimensions are sensitive to perturbations and can serve as decoding-anomaly indicators, enabling an accurate detector via encode-decode consistency. It also explores correcting specific dimensions. It matters for reliable multimodal representation analysis.

entry.title: $M^3 QuestionIng$: Multi-modal Multi-span Medical Question Answering

author.name: Anisha Saha, Vaibhav Rathore, Abhisek Tiwari, Akash Ghosh, Sai Ruthvik Edara, Sriparna Saha

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal, multi-span medical question-answering framework that incorporates visual cues alongside text when answers span multiple document sections. Targets real-world MedQA where source documents combine textual and visual content.

entry.title: A Good Talk Does not Look Like a Summary, It Teaches You! Measuring Takeaways from Paper-to-Video Talks

author.name: Ishani Mondal, Aparna Garimella, Ananya Sai, Pannaga Shivaswamy, Jordan Boyd-Graber

entry.summary: Introduces EffectivePresentationScorer, which evaluates whether AI-generated paper-to-video talks actually teach ideas rather than just summarize, checking clarity, background introduction, and connection to contributions. Finds generated videos mention points but fall short on instructional effectiveness.

entry.title: Low-cost concept-based localized explanations: How far can we get with training-free approaches?

author.name: Darian Fern\'andez-Guti\'errez, Rafael Bello, Marilyn Bello, Natalia D\'iaz-Rodr\'iguez

entry.summary: Evaluates whether mid-scale MLLMs can perform localized concept naming at object and part levels under strict zero-shot conditions, proposing closed-set and open-vocabulary (Open-CoNa) protocols. Investigates how far training-free concept-based explainability can go without fine-grained annotations.

entry.title: Automated Quality Assessment of Geospatial Vector Data: A GeoAI Approach using Spatial Representation Learning

author.name: Hao Li, Chen Chu, Filip Biljecki, Cyrus Shahabi, Wenwen Li

entry.summary: Topo4Vec is an automated GeoAI framework for assessing geospatial vector data quality via spatial representation learning, using topological error simulation to avoid labor-intensive annotation. It targets scalable detection of errors like overlapping polygons and network connectivity faults.

entry.title: DCSNet: Multiscale Feature Aggregation for Small Medical Object Segmentation with Detection-guided Hierarchical Cropping

author.name: Shanfeng Zhang, Bo Gou, Yue Cao, Lei Zhang, Zhang Yi, Tao He

entry.summary: DCSNet tackles small medical object segmentation with detection-guided hierarchical cropping to focus on object-centric regions and multiscale feature aggregation to handle class imbalance and boundary complexity. It converts global dense prediction into localized refinement.

entry.title: Anomaly Factory 3D: A Modular Framework for Diverse Pseudo-Anomaly Synthesis in Unsupervised 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Ali Balapour, Faraz Hach

entry.summary: Anomaly Factory 3D synthesizes diverse pseudo-anomalies from normal point clouds via parametric deformation models to expand training data for unsupervised 3D anomaly detection. It offers a modular, preset-rich defect generation pipeline.

entry.title: LEIQ-Assessor: Multi-dimensional Quality Assessment of Low-light Enhanced Images via Multi-task Learning

author.name: Wei Sun, Yanwei Jiang, Dandan Zhu, Jinqiu Sang, Jikai Xu, Weixia Zhang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: LEIQ-Assessor is a multi-task learning model for multi-dimensional quality assessment of low-light enhanced images, capturing artifacts such as noise amplification, color shift, structural damage, and over-exposure. It was developed for a QoMEX 2026 grand challenge.

entry.title: LLM-based Multimodal Personality Recognition via Facial Action Unit-Text Semantic Fusion

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, Wei Shan, Yuan Zong, Tianhua Qi, Wenming Zheng

entry.summary: An LLM-based multimodal framework for personality recognition in video interviews that fuses facial action units, converted into interpretable text descriptions, with interviewees' textual responses. It targets recruitment screening while preserving fine-grained facial temporal cues.

entry.title: HASTE: A Framework for Training-Free, Dynamic, and Steerable Compression of Pre-Trained Convolutional Neural Networks

author.name: Lukas Meiner, Jens Mehnert, Alexandru Paul Condurache

entry.summary: HASTE is a training-free, plug-and-play convolution module that dynamically compresses pre-trained CNNs at inference by using locality-sensitive hashing to merge redundant feature channels patch-wise. It requires no fine-tuning or data access, easing deployment on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: Multimodal Graph RAG for Long-range Visually Rich Document Understanding

author.name: Yi-Cheng Wang, Chu-Song Chen

entry.summary: This paper introduces multimodal Graph RAG for long-range visually rich document understanding, building multimodal knowledge graphs that summarize global document knowledge to support holistic VQA beyond page-level retrieval. It addresses MLLM context-window limits and the lack of multimodal KG construction methods.

entry.title: Model Merging to Evolution: Parameter Space Exploration for Expert Models

author.name: Chao Wang, Yuchen Guo, Zheng Tan, Guanchun Wang, Yanbiao Ma, Qiqi Duan, Peng Wu

entry.summary: MERGEvolve unifies model merging and evolution strategies by treating a merged expert model as the initialization for evolutionary parameter-space exploration, escaping the convex-combination subspace to find higher-performance regions. It provides theoretical motivation and an evolution phase using random noise.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models for Deployable Social Robot Navigation: Bridging Semantic Reasoning and Low-Level Control

author.name: Runji Cai, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Ling Xiao

entry.summary: This paper integrates Vision-Language Models into social robot navigation, bridging high-level semantic reasoning and commonsense understanding with reliable low-level metric planning and collision avoidance for real-time, safety-critical deployment. It addresses how to translate VLM reasoning into socially compliant navigation behaviors.

entry.title: LNN-Fly: Continuous-Time UAV Navigation for Robust Obstacle Avoidance under Timing Mismatch

author.name: Yulin Huang, Shaojie Chen, Di Feng, Jiahao Wang, Ping Liu, Jianxiao Zou

entry.summary: LNN-Fly is a deployment-oriented continuous-time UAV obstacle-avoidance policy combining a dynamic-programming-inspired structured recurrent update, explicit conditioning on elapsed control interval, and an input-driven adaptive forgetting gate to refresh stale observations. It targets robustness to timing mismatch, sensing irregularity, and variable-rate control after deployment.

entry.title: Reachability Guarantees for Cart-Pole Swing-Up and Stabilization

author.name: Mohamed Khalid M Jaffar

entry.summary: Presents a reachability analysis of a switched energy-based/LQR controller for cart-pole swing-up and stabilization, certifying convergence to the upright equilibrium from a compact set of initial conditions using Lyapunov functions and LaSalle's invariance principle. It also regulates steady-state cart velocity to zero.

entry.title: Segmentation-free analysis of live-cell imaging data reveals how T cell modifications influence cancer cell aggregation dynamics

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: A Nature Scientific Reports paper presenting a segmentation-free machine learning analysis of live-cell imaging to reveal how T cell modifications affect cancer cell aggregation dynamics. It applies ML to extract dynamics directly without explicit cell segmentation. This is applied ML in cancer biology.

entry.title: Narrative-UFET: Narrative Generation for Ultra-Fine Entity Typing

author.name: Mreedul Gupta, Advait Deshmukh, Ashwin Umadi, Matt Pauk, Maria Leonor Pacheco

entry.summary: Narrative-UFET extends ultra-fine entity typing with automatically generated coherent narratives per mention to test whether disambiguating evidence spread across sentences helps long-tail types. Provides Maintain and varying paired narrative variants to isolate discourse effects.

entry.title: KG2Cypher: Data-Centric Pipeline for Building Enterprise Text-to-Cypher Systems

author.name: Minjun Choi, Yerin Kim, Junghyuk Seo, Sujin Mo, Hyemin Lee, Youngjoong Ko

entry.summary: KG2Cypher is a data-centric pipeline for building enterprise text-to-Cypher systems from existing knowledge graphs by constructing executable Cypher from graph facts then generating natural-language questions, validated by LLM judge and human review. Enables NL interfaces for private enterprise graphs.

entry.title: Output-Space Allocation Costs for Calibration-Guided LLM Compression: An Empirical Study

author.name: Qiong Tang, Xiangkun Hu, Xiangyang Liu, Yiran Chen, Yunfan Shao

entry.summary: An empirical study examining whether aligning the MCKP allocation cost with the output-space objective improves calibration-guided LLM compression (ROCKET-ActCost), finding higher accuracy (+0.8pp) but worse perplexity (+16%) on Qwen3-8B at 50% compression. Surfaces an accuracy-perplexity trade-off.

entry.title: A Kernel Fisher Discriminant Analysis-Based Tree Ensemble Classifier: KFDA Forest

author.name: Donghwan Kim, Seung Hwan Park, Jun-Geol Baek

entry.summary: KFDA Forest is a tree-based ensemble applying kernel Fisher discriminant analysis on randomly partitioned variable subsets with bootstrapping. It maximizes between-class distance while minimizing within-class distance via the kernel trick.

entry.title: From Detecting Agency to Doing Work: Self-Caused Credit Builds a Durable Behavioral Self in a Minimal Spiking Agent

author.name: Haoliang Han

entry.summary: This work shows that an agency-gated slow-credit mechanism produces durable self-shaped behavior in a minimal spiking agent, where a learned self-preserving choice survives episodic buffer removal but collapses when slow decoders are reset or the agency gate is removed. It connects detecting agency to building a behavioral self. It matters for computational models of agency and self.

entry.title: Can MLLMs Critique Like Humans? Evaluating Open-Ended Aesthetic Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Sajjad Ghiasvand, Maryam Amirizaniani, Haniyeh Ehsani Oskouie, Mahnoosh Alizadeh, Ramtin Pedarsani

entry.summary: Evaluates open-weight MLLMs on open-ended aesthetic photo critique against ranked human references using the Reddit Photo Critique Dataset under six prompt conditions. Probes how persona, hinting, and grounding affect alignment with human critiques.

entry.title: Estimating Grammatical Gender Directions in Contextual Embeddings under Controlled and Natural Contexts

author.name: Huanping Xiao, Yingji Li

entry.summary: Makes a first attempt to disentangle grammatical gender from social-semantic bias in contextual embeddings for gendered languages like Spanish, using controlled templates and natural Wikipedia contexts. Compares centroid, SVM, and LDA gender-direction estimators with contamination-aware weighting.

entry.title: TRACE: Temporal Relationship-Aware Conversational Entrainment Detection in Dyadic Speech

author.name: Sathvik Manikantan Napa Ugandhar, Hao Zhang, Alison Gunzler, Yuzhe Wang, Thomas Thebaud, Georgi Tinchev, Venkatesh Ravichandran, Laureano Moro-Vel\'azquez

entry.summary: Introduces DyadEE, a dataset for emotional entrainment detection in dyadic speech with entrained and disrupted interactions, and TRACE, a window-level model using emotion-finetuned Whisper embeddings. Models conversational affective coordination over time.

entry.title: The Digital Afterlife of Empires: Four Language Models Converge on the Same Imperial Cartography of Writing

author.name: Hiroki Fukui

entry.summary: Constructs the Digital Script Representation Index across 300 writing systems and finds only about 10% are fully supported by digital infrastructure, with tokenizer efficiency varying 31-fold. A mediation model links imperial intervention through speaker population and web corpus to tokenizer efficiency.

entry.title: Improving Large-Scale Weakly Supervised ASR by Filtering and Selection

author.name: Kohei Matsuura, Masato Mimura

entry.summary: Improves large-scale weakly supervised ASR via a three-step recipe: full-data pretraining, CER-based filtered continued pretraining, and fine-tuning on acoustically similar in-domain samples. Demonstrates gains on a 90,000-hour weakly supervised Japanese dataset.

entry.title: Semantic-Aware Generative Image Transmission for Resource-Constrained Visual IoT Systems

author.name: Chenyang Zhang, Changwang Liu, Jinqi Zhu, Jiayi Chang, Yuxuan Wang, Shuqing He, Jia Guo

entry.summary: This paper presents a semantic-aware generative image transmission framework for resource-constrained visual IoT, encoding images into VQ token grids and exploiting receiver-side generative restoration to reduce transmitted data over low-rate links. It targets task-relevant visual evidence transmission for edge devices.

entry.title: DeVAR: Low-Dose CT Denoising via Visual Autoregressive Modeling

author.name: Xizhuo Zhang, Yannian Gu, Zhongzhen Huang, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: DeVAR applies visual autoregressive modeling to low-dose CT denoising for the first time, conditioning on global LDCT context to capture global-to-local structural dependencies and preserve fine anatomical detail. It positions VAR as an alternative generative paradigm to diffusion for medical denoising.

entry.title: FalconTrack: Photorealistic Auto-Labeled Perception and Physics-Aware Vision-Based Aerial Tracking

author.name: Yan Miao, Karteek Gandiboyina, Noah Giles, Hideki Okamoto, Bardh Hoxha, Georgios Fainekos, Sayan Mitra

entry.summary: FalconTrack is a vision-based aerial tracking framework that auto-generates photorealistic labeled data in a Gaussian Splatting simulator (isolating target Gaussians and compositing with randomized backgrounds) and combines multi-head perception with physics-aware tracking for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. It targets GPS-denied environments.

entry.title: Supervised Hebbian learning in Deep Counterstream Associative Networks

author.name: Andreas Knoblauch

entry.summary: This work proposes supervised Hebbian learning in deep counterstream associative networks as a more biologically realistic alternative to backpropagation, avoiding requirements like symmetric connectivity, separate error channels, and special operations such as subtraction or inversion. It targets biologically plausible credit assignment.

entry.title: RelBall: Relation Ball with Quaternion Rotation for Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Yike Liu, Peijia Xie, Chao He, Huiling Zhu

entry.summary: RelBall introduces a knowledge-graph completion model using relation balls with quaternion rotation to capture non-commutative composition, semantic hierarchy, and one-to-many relations that prior models like RotatE and Rotate3D miss.

entry.title: Agentic Publication Protocol: An Attempt to Modernize Scientific Publication

author.name: Sirui Lu, Xiao-Liang Qi

entry.summary: Proposes the Agentic Publication Protocol, a lightweight version-controlled repository format packaging papers with code, data, environment, reproducibility instructions, and an agent-facing instruction file. Aims to publish operational know-how usable by LLM agents.

entry.title: An Integrated Machine Learning and Hierarchical Variance Decomposition Pipeline for Student Performance Prediction and Metacognitive Calibration on Multi-Signal Telemetry

author.name: Gurdeep Singh Virdee

entry.summary: UBP-CAP integrates student performance prediction, metacognitive calibration error analysis, and variance decomposition into one pipeline using LightGBM with SHAP, calibration metrics, and a crossed GLMM. Targets personalization in intelligent tutoring systems.

entry.title: Temporal Posed and Spontaneous Gesture Recognition from Electromyography in the Rock-Paper-Scissors Game

author.name: Xin Wei, Huakun Liu, Felix Dollack, Monica Perusquia-Hernandez

entry.summary: Explores temporal characteristics of electromyography for recognizing posed and spontaneous gestures in a Rock-Paper-Scissors game, finding EMG onsets detectable ~800ms before visible gestures. Evaluates self-gesture recognition accuracy under both conditions.

entry.title: Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Estimating Market-Outcome Distributions via Swarms of Persona-Conditioned Neural Policy Bots in a Limit Order Book

author.name: Salavat Ishbulatov

entry.summary: Proposes Persona-Trained Monte Carlo, simulating limit-order-book markets with swarms of persona-conditioned neural trading bots sharing one policy to estimate distributions of market-outcome statistics. Each simulation run produces one price-path Monte Carlo sample.

entry.title: t-STEP: An interpretable model for Total Electron Content predictions and irregularities estimations

author.name: Stephen Tete, Carl Shneider, Maxime Cordy, Claudio Cesaroni, Andreas Hein, Vasily Petrov

entry.summary: Presents t-STEP, an interpretable ML model predicting ionospheric Total Electron Content at 30-second resolution to estimate small-scale irregularities affecting GPS and satellite communications. The high cadence preserves fine-scale signatures missed by hourly models.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated Inverse Structural Anastylosis from Block Collapse Dynamics

author.name: L. A. Mu\~noz

entry.summary: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated deep learning framework that treats structural anastylosis (reassembling collapsed stone monuments) as an inverse prediction task, inspired by Jenga collapse dynamics. Given an image of collapsed blocks, it reconstructs the most probable original configuration.

entry.title: Exploring the Effects of Entanglement on Quantum Machine Learning of Pathogen Epitope-Receptor Binding

author.name: Aspen Erlandsson Brisebois, Luis Pablo Gonzalez Dominguez, Shivansi Prajapati, Zahed Khatooni, Heather L. Wilson, Connor Burbridge, Brook Byrns, Sureesh Tikoo, Christophe Pere, Steven Rayan, Gordon Broderick

entry.summary: This study examines how the number and topology of two-qubit entangling gates in the feature-map stage affect a hybrid quantum neural network classifying strong versus weak epitope-receptor binding for PRRS vaccine design. It uses a small dataset of 80 docking-derived 9-mer epitope affinities on NISQ-relevant circuits.

entry.title: Liquidity-Based Audit of Algorithmic Trading Strategies

author.name: Irene Aldridge

entry.summary: This work shows that an algorithmic trading strategy's net liquidity demand can be identified from trade and price history alone, without knowing its signal or objective. It connects a regret decomposition to the classic Kyle informed-trader vs market-maker dichotomy and the Roll spread. It matters for auditing algorithmic trading and detecting liquidity imbalances.

entry.title: Bridging the Gap Between Image Restoration and Navigational Safety in Hazy Conditions: A New Visibility Estimation Metric for Maritime Surveillance

author.name: Wentao Feng, Guobei Peng, Wengang Mao, Ryan Wen Liu

entry.summary: This work proposes a visibility-oriented evaluation framework linking image-dehazing quality to physically interpretable visible-distance estimation for maritime surveillance, where conventional metrics like PSNR and SSIM fail. It connects restoration to navigational safety thresholds. It matters for safety-aware maritime image processing.

entry.title: Notes on generative modeling: flow matching, diffusion, optimal transport and Schr{\"o}dinger bridge

author.name: Titouan Vayer (COMPACT)

entry.summary: These notes recapitulate the high-level mathematical principles connecting flow matching, diffusion, optimal transport, and Schrödinger bridges for generative modeling. They serve as a unifying tutorial of these techniques. It matters as an educational synthesis for generative-modeling researchers.

entry.title: 5ting at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Strong End-to-End Multi-Turn RAG via LLM-Based Reranking and Faithfulness Control

author.name: Thien-Qua-T-Nguyen, Chi Hoang, Nguyen Tran, Tri Le, Khanh Truong, Chinh Trong Nguyen

entry.summary: Describes a SemEval-2026 multi-turn RAG system combining BGE-M3 dense retrieval, dual-query merged retrieval, LLM-based reranking, and faithfulness-constrained generation. Reports competition-level retrieval and end-to-end scores.

entry.title: How LLMs See Creativity: Zero-Shot Scoring of Visual Creativity with Interpretable Reasoning

author.name: William Orwig, Roger E. Beaty

entry.summary: Tests whether multimodal LLMs can score visual creativity zero-shot and whether their reasoning traces are interpretable, evaluating six models on nearly 1000 AI-generated images. Examines alignment between model ratings and human creativity judgments.

entry.title: Node-to-Neighborhood Semantic Consistency: Text-Topology Alignment for TAGs Anomaly Detection

author.name: Bochen Lin, Jianxiang Yu, Jiayi Wu, Lin Qi, Huang Lu, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Formalizes text-attributed-graph anomaly detection as a node-to-neighborhood semantic-consistency problem, aligning textual semantics with graph topology. Targets nodes whose semantics are inconsistent with their neighborhoods for fraud and integrity applications.

entry.title: Multi-Agentic System Leveraging Open-Source LLMs to Mitigate Disinformation Threats

author.name: Sebastian Kula, Martin Tamajka

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent disinformation-detection system using open-source LLMs that emulates human annotators with a consensus mechanism and cognitive diversity. Aims to scale automated fact-checking beyond manual verification.

entry.title: Who Plays Which Role When? Communication Role Dynamics for Peer Recognition and Team Performance Prediction

author.name: Yifan Song, Wenxuan Wendy Shi, Brian P Bailey, Tal August

entry.summary: Operationalizes an eight-role communication taxonomy grounded in education theory and annotates 6,307 Slack messages from 55 students, testing whether LLMs can approximate expert role labels. Analyzes role dynamics over team lifecycles for peer recognition and performance prediction.

entry.title: Clustering Unsupervised Representations as Defense against Poisoning Attacks on Speech Commands Classification System

author.name: Thomas Thebaud, Sonal Joshi, Henry Li, Martin Sustek, Jesus Villalba, Sanjeev Khudanpur, Najim Dehak

entry.summary: Proposes a filtering defense against dirty-label poisoning of speech-command classifiers using DINO unsupervised representations clustered with K-means and LDA, keeping majority-label utterances per cluster. Discards likely poisoned samples whose labels disagree with their cluster.

entry.title: Few-class Fidelity: Evaluating Explanations of Real-conditions CNN classifiers with Optimized Perturbations

author.name: Wistan Marchadour, Pedro Soto Vega, Franck Vermet, Mathieu Hatt

entry.summary: This paper proposes a variant of Fidelity-based XAI metrics tailored to real-world low-class-count CNN classifiers, generating in-distribution uncertainty-provoking perturbations for more reliable explanation evaluation. It addresses inconsistency in comparing XAI methods.

entry.title: AEGIS: A Semantic GAN and Evidential Learning Frameworkfor Robust Adversarial Detection in Vision Sensors

author.name: Maher Boughdiri, Mounira Msahli, Albert Bifet

entry.summary: AEGIS combines a semantic GAN discriminator with evidential learning to detect adversarial inputs in vision sensor pipelines, filtering inconsistent inputs and using uncertainty-guided test-time augmentation. It targets robust image classification against imperceptible perturbations.

entry.title: Confidence-feedback-weighted graph matching network: online-offline laser-induced damage site matching under complex interference

author.name: Yueyue Han, Guanhua Chen, Hangcheng Dong, Kang Zhang, Fengdong Chen, Zhitao Peng, Fa Zeng, Qihua Zhu, Guodong Liu

entry.summary: A confidence-feedback-weighted graph matching network matches online and offline laser-induced damage sites in high-power laser facilities using only centroid coordinates. It iteratively estimates node matchability confidence to suppress distractors.

entry.title: W4A4 Quantization for Inference on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B

author.name: Yidong Chen, Chengyu Shi, Jiahao Liu

entry.summary: This challenge submission applies 4-bit weight and activation quantization to the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B video generation model, combining mixed precision for outliers and per-channel smoothing with block-wise HiF4 packing. It adapts LLM quantization ideas to diffusion video models.

entry.title: High-Resolution Flood Mapping With Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 via Misalignment-Robust Cross-Sensor Learning and Generative Despeckling

author.name: David Ma, Jeremy Feinstein, Shreya Pandit, Arkaprabha Ganguli, Eugene Yan

entry.summary: This work presents a flood-mapping framework fusing Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical imagery with misalignment-robust cross-sensor learning and generative despeckling, plus a new pixel-accurate 10m water-mask dataset over the contiguous US. It emphasizes challenging urban and adverse-weather conditions.

entry.title: Road to scalability for efficient graph search on massively parallel neuromorphic hardware

author.name: Oskar von Seeler, Elena C. Offenberg, Carlo Michaelis, Tomas Kulvicius, Jannik Luboeinski, Andrew B. Lehr, Christian Tetzlaff

entry.summary: NEURO-MAPP is a distributed shortest-path algorithm designed for neuromorphic hardware, implemented and optimized on SpiNNaker 2 and compared against Dijkstra on a CPU. It demonstrates favorable scaling by exploiting local computation and network communication for graph search.

entry.title: CubifyGS: Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Lifelong Dynamic Scene Maintenance

author.name: Bohan Ren (Beijing Institute of Technology), Dianyi Yang (Beijing Institute of Technology), Shiyang Liu (Beijing Institute of Technology), Yu Gao (Beijing Institute of Technology), Jiadong Tang (Beijing Institute of Technology), Zhilin Lai (Guangzhou Saite Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd), Yi Yang (Beijing Institute of Technology), Mengyin Fu (Beijing Institute of Technology)

entry.summary: CubifyGS is an object-centric 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for lifelong dynamic scene maintenance that models movable instances as reusable Gaussian assets and updates maps via asset retrieval, rigid transformation, and pruning rather than re-optimization. It reduces ghosting and slow recovery under object rearrangement.

entry.title: Multi-UAV Formation Cooperative Obstacle Avoidance and Adaptive Shape Deformation Control in Complex Environments Based on BI-APF-RRT and Affine Transformation

author.name: Yiliang Wu, Weican Chen, Yendo Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-UAV formation obstacle avoidance and shape deformation method combining bidirectional APF-RRT path planning with affine transformations to maintain formation integrity while avoiding local optima. It targets complex obstacle environments.

entry.title: Realtime Wind Estimation using Low Cost Quadrotor Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles

author.name: Hiranya Udagedara, Mahdis Bisheban

entry.summary: Presents a real-time wind velocity estimation method using low-cost quadrotor UAVs that improves over prior EKF-based approaches limited to hovering or near-linear trajectories. It targets environmental monitoring and emergency-response applications like wildfires.

entry.title: AI will make biological extinction risks worse before it makes them better

author.name: MichaelDickens

entry.summary: An argumentative essay contending that AI will worsen biological extinction risks in the near term by accelerating dangerous biology research before any aligned superintelligence could mitigate them. It challenges the framing that rushing to build ASI protects against non-AI extinction risks. The piece is opinion/argument rather than empirical analysis.

entry.title: hia-gat: A Heterogeneous Interaction-Aware Graph Attention Network For Frame-Level Traffic Conflict Risk Prediction On Freeways

author.name: Mahshid Malazizi, Seyedmehdi Khaleghian, Mina Sartipi, Toru Hirano, Yunfei Xu, Hoang H. Nguyen

entry.summary: HIA-GAT formulates frame-level freeway traffic conflict risk as a multi-agent scene-graph binary classification, using a dual-stream heterogeneous graph attention network for longitudinal and lateral vehicle interactions with physics-informed edge features. Targets real-time crash-risk prediction.

entry.title: An Integrated Two-Stage Deep-Learning Tool for Rapid Post-Hurricane Damage Identification and Repair Scheduling

author.name: Hooman Torkaman, Ellis Oti Boateng, Jignesh Solanki, Anurag Srivastava

entry.summary: This paper presents a two-stage deep-learning tool for rapid post-hurricane power-grid damage identification and repair scheduling, benchmarking architectures like GraphSAGE and Set Transformer on a synthetic IEEE feeder dataset. It replaces computationally intensive simulation and optimization. It matters for resilient infrastructure response.

entry.title: The Undecidability of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Alignment

author.name: Jose Pascual Gumbau Mezquita

entry.summary: Argues the core barrier to AGI safety is the structural unverifiability of alignment, proving two impossibility theorems grounded in computability limits like Trakhtenbrot's Wall and Rice's theorem. Concludes finite-hardware engineering defenses cannot escape these logical obstructions.

entry.title: MedDiffuseMix: Preserving Diagnostic Evidence with Saliency-Aware Diffusion Medical Image Data Augmentatio

author.name: Teerath Kumar, Raja Vavekanand, Muhammad Turab

entry.summary: MedDiffuseMix is a saliency-guided diffusion data augmentation method that uses classifier saliency maps to confine generative mixing to low-importance background regions, preserving diagnostic structures while increasing training diversity. It addresses class imbalance and limited data in medical image classification.

entry.title: Beyond 2D Matching: A Unified Single-Stage Framework for Geometry-Aware Cross-View Object Geo-Localization

author.name: Liyao Wang, Ruipu Wu, Haojun Xu, Lei Shi, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu

entry.summary: This work tackles cross-view object geo-localization with a unified single-stage geometry-aware framework and a new large-scale building dataset (220k+ ground/drone-satellite pairs) featuring multimodal prompts and camera poses. It moves beyond pure 2D appearance matching toward explicit spatial modeling.

entry.title: Anatomy-Grounded Synthetic Coronary Angiography for Geometry-Informed Multi-View Matching

author.name: In Kyu Lee, Sumin Seo, Jaesik Min

entry.summary: This work generates anatomy-grounded synthetic coronary angiography by simulating realistic C-arm acquisition geometry from 3D CCTA volumes, producing dense 3D-to-2D projection labels at zero human cost. It addresses the data bottleneck for multi-view correspondence matching needed in 3D coronary reconstruction.

entry.title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision

author.name: Haoyang Li, Guanlin Li, Youhe Feng, Chen Zhao, Zhuoran Wang, Yang Li, Qizhe Wei, Shifeng Bao, Haitao Shen, Yihan Zhao, Tong Yang, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: This work proposes a unified modality-aware visuo-tactile policy that derives fine-grained contact states from tactile motion correlation rather than raw images or cumulative motion fields, reducing perception ambiguity. It targets contact-rich robotic manipulation with optical tactile sensors.

entry.title: Unified Complex-valued Neural Network: A Magnitude-Phase Computational Model for Event-Driven Neuromorphic Learning

author.name: Reza Ahmadvand, Sarah Safura Sharif, Yaser Mike Banad

entry.summary: This paper introduces a Unified Complex-valued Neuron model where magnitude encodes signal strength and phase governs temporal evolution and spike emission, bridging continuous ANN activation and event-driven SNN timing in one structure. It is trained with a combined backpropagation and BPTT framework.

entry.title: When May I Help You? On The Effect of Proactivity on Group Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Thomas Vitry, Vanessa Maeder, Kieran Edgeworth, Asihati Hazaiti, Doga Deniz Ates, Connor G\"ade, Jan-Gerrit Habekost, Dennis Becker, Stefan Wermter

entry.summary: This study investigates how robot proactivity affects multi-party human-robot collaboration through a collaborative escape-room experiment comparing reactive (responds only when addressed) versus proactive (continuously contributes and re-initiates) interaction models. It evaluates puzzle-solving performance, interaction dynamics, and user perception.

entry.title: an open-source repo for embryo selection

author.name: Dawn Drain

entry.summary: Announces an open-source repository for polygenic prediction and embryo selection that pulls predictors from the PGS catalog, uses an LLM to select best weights, and rederives state-of-the-art predictors from open GWAS summary statistics. It includes a technical essay and slides. This is a practical bioinformatics tool release.

entry.title: OverFlowLight: Real-Time Gridlock Prevention and Traffic Signal Optimization for Urban Intersections

author.name: Mingyuan Li, Boyang Huang, Tianqi Jiang, Chenpu Li, Chunyu Liu, Yang Li, Ruimin Li, Qiang Wu

entry.summary: OverFlowLight is a real-time traffic signal control framework that detects queue overflow via camera/radar multimodal sensing and inserts dedicated overflow-clearing phases to prevent cascading gridlock. Targets peak-hour congestion beyond throughput optimization.

entry.title: CW-B: Class Weighted Boosting Framework for Imbalance Resilient Multi Class Cardiac Phenotyping

author.name: Sijia Li, Xiaoyu Tan, Chen Zhan, Yuanji Ma, Haoyu Wang, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes CW-B, a clinical risk-aligned class-weighted XGBoost pipeline for five-class cardiac discharge phenotyping under real-world class imbalance and missingness, combining fold-specific balanced weighting, missingness indicators, and classwise error auditing. It prioritizes recognition of high-risk phenotypes while preserving interpretability.

entry.title: DBpedia-Enriched Company Representation for B2B Lead Recommendation

author.name: Yuyan Qian, Claude Montacie, Milan Stankovic, Victoria Eyharabide

entry.summary: This study enriches company embeddings with DBpedia semantic knowledge to improve B2B lead recommendation, integrating structured attributes and text embeddings on a real platform. It evaluates downstream interaction prediction with real user feedback.

entry.title: Analysis of Parameter Settings for the Bat Algorithm Using Variance Evolution

author.name: Xin-She Yang, Mehmet Karamanoglu

entry.summary: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of parameter settings for the bat algorithm using dynamical systems theory and population-variance evolution to derive parameter ranges. Numerical experiments are shown to be consistent with the theoretical bounds.

entry.title: Connectivity Estimation using Stochastic Graph Heat Modelling

author.name: Stephan Goerttler, Min Wu, Fei He

entry.summary: This work extends a noise-driven graph heat modelling framework for estimating brain connectivity, relaxing noise assumptions and adding regularization for robustness. It targets model-based, dynamic, multivariate, and directed connectivity estimation lacking in prior methods. It matters for neurophysiological data analysis.

entry.title: Consensus Clustering of Free-Viewing Gaze Data: New Insights into Human-Information Interaction

author.name: Beryl Gnanaraj, Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair, Saqib Alam Ansari, Maanasa Rajaraman

entry.summary: EnsembleGaze is an end-to-end unsupervised ensemble system for consensus clustering of free-viewing gaze data, using fixation-distribution statistical descriptors to characterize user behavior and stimulus type. It studies under-explored human-information interaction patterns. It matters for understanding human visual attention.

entry.title: Fund2Persona: A Framework for Building and Refining Financial Advisor Personas from Fund Disclosure Data

author.name: Suhwan Park, Hoyoung Lee, Zhangyang Wang, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Young Cha, Chanyeol Choi, Jaewon Choi, Yongjae Lee

entry.summary: Presents Fund2Persona, which grounds LLM financial-advisor personas in fund disclosures and manager commentary, then refines them through an agentic actor-scorer-patcher loop. Shows improved recovery of portfolio decisions over generic persona prompts.

entry.title: Comparing Human and Automatic Recognition of Dutch Dysarthric Continuous Speech: A Case Study

author.name: Yuanyuan Zhang, Dimme de Groot, Jorge Martinez, Odette Scharenborg

entry.summary: Compares human listeners and three off-the-shelf ASR systems (Whisper-large-V3, Google Chirp 3, Omnilingual) on Dutch dysarthric continuous speech, finding both exceed 70% WER. Shows fine-tuning produces personalized models that outperform human listeners.

entry.title: Poller: Are LLMs Suitable for Evaluating the Poetry Understanding Task?

author.name: Shanshan Wang, Derek F. Wong, Jingming Yao, Lidia S. Chao
